function generateCourseChangeGuideLines()
    cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = {}

    if not pivotPosition or not startForwardVec then return end

    local MIN_RANGE, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC, MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC = getMovementParameters()
    local guideLen = 5 * UNIT_SCALE

    local leftLimitVec  = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
    local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y',  MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)

    local leftEnd  = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec  * guideLen)
    local rightEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * guideLen)

    -- Convert to local space so setVectorLines works correctly
    local localOrigin = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
    localOrigin.y = localOrigin.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

    local localLeft  = self.positionToLocal(leftEnd)
    localLeft.y  = localLeft.y  + LINE_Y_OFFSET
    local localRight = self.positionToLocal(rightEnd)
    localRight.y = localRight.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

    table.insert(cachedCourseChangeGuideLines, {
        points    = { localOrigin, localLeft },
        color     = {1, 1, 1},
        thickness = 0.08,
        rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
    })
    table.insert(cachedCourseChangeGuideLines, {
        points    = { localOrigin, localRight },
        color     = {1, 1, 1},
        thickness = 0.08,
        rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
    })
end

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}

    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end

    -- Calculate scan radius to match scan lines
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * (10/3) * UNIT_SCALE

    -- Set arc line length to 16" (extends 16" on each side = 32" total)
        local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
        local arcLineLength = 16 * UNIT_SCALE / scale

    -- Helper to add symmetric lines with custom color
    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg, lineColor)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)

        -- Line 1 (Right side) - extends from -arcLineLength to +arcLineLength
        local p1 = rotRight * arcLineLength
        local p2 = rotRight * (-arcLineLength)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })

        -- Line 2 (Left side)
        local p3 = rotLeft * arcLineLength
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-arcLineLength)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end

    -- Front/Side/Rear (45 degrees) - Dark Red
    addAngleLines(45, {0, 0, 0.6})

    -- Front/Rear Narrow (11 degrees) - Dark Blue
    addAngleLines(11, {0.6, 0, 0})
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}    -- Light Green

    -- Circle Scan Range - use ShipScan variable
    local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * UNIT_SCALE / scale

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * scanRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * scanRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function onPickUp(player_color)
      -- Reset move tracker when starting a new radial move
      accumulatedDistance = 0
      UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()

      -- Check if MoveOff is active - if so, skip radial movement setup
      -- If Free Move is active (or deploying), radial movement and vectored logic are disabled
      if IsFreeMove() then
          isHeld = false

          -- Hard reset any in-progress vectored / course-change sequencing
          vectoredPhase = 1
          vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
          vectoredReminderActive = false

          -- Optional but recommended, avoids “half-complete” states lingering
          courseChangePhase = 1
          courseChangeDistance = 0

          return
      end


    isHeld = true
    holdingPlayerColor = player_color

    -- Store pickup position/rotation for undo (do this FIRST)
    pickupPosition = self.getPosition()
    pickupRotation = self.getRotation()

    -- Record the position and rotation where the object was picked up
    pivotPosition = self.getPosition()  -- Always use current position as pivot
    startRotation = self.getRotation()
    currentSmoothedPos = self.getPosition()

    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"

    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        -- Do NOT auto-advance phases on pickup.
        -- Phases are advanced onDrop (especially important for vectored ships).
        if courseChangePhase == nil then courseChangePhase = 1 end
        if courseChangeDistance == nil then courseChangeDistance = 0 end
    else
        -- Reset Course Change tracking when leaving the order
        courseChangePhase = 1
        courseChangeDistance = 0
    end


    -- VECTORED: two-leg movement for ANY order (except CourseChange, which already has its own 2-phase logic)
    if Vectored and activeOrder ~= "CourseChange" then
        -- If we completed leg 1 previously, next pickup becomes leg 2
        if vectoredPhase == 1 and vectoredLeg1Distance > 0 then
            vectoredPhase = 2
            print("[FFAA00]Vectored: Phase 2 - extra 45° bend then remaining move [-]")
        elseif vectoredPhase ~= 2 then
            -- Starting fresh
            vectoredPhase = 1
            vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
        end
    else
        -- Not vectored (or CourseChange), always reset vectored state
        vectoredPhase = 1
        vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
    end


    -- Determine the starting "Forward" vector based on the model configuration
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformRight() -- Local X-axis
    else
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformForward() -- Local Z-axis
    end
    -- Flatten Y to ensure 2D calculations
    startForwardVec.y = 0
    startForwardVec:normalize()
end

function onDrop(player_color)
    -- TRACKING: Add current segment to accumulated distance
    if isHeld and pickupPosition then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local dist = Vector.distance(pickupPosition, currentPos) / UNIT_SCALE
        accumulatedDistance = accumulatedDistance + dist
        -- Update UI immediately
        UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()
    end

    isHeld = false
    holdingPlayerColor = nil

    -- Clear physics velocities to prevent "fling" effect on release
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))

    local freeMove = IsFreeMove()
    if freeMove then
        -- If they free-moved the ship, never progress vectored/course change sequencing
        vectoredPhase = 1
        vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
        vectoredReminderActive = false

        -- Keep aura visuals correct
        updateAuraVisuals()
        return
    end

    -- COURSE CHANGE: phase progression handled onDrop
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local diffX = currentPos.x - pivotPosition.x
        local diffZ = currentPos.z - pivotPosition.z
        local movedDistance = math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffZ * diffZ) / UNIT_SCALE

        if not Vectored then
                    -- Normal Course Change: Phase 1 (move) -> Phase 2 (rotate only) -> reset
                    if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                        if movedDistance > 0.1 then
                            courseChangeDistance = movedDistance
                            courseChangePhase = 2
                            courseChangeReminderActive = true
                            generateCourseChangeGuideLines()
                            broadcastToAll("[22AA22]Course Change: Phase 1 complete - Moved " ..
                                string.format("%.1f", courseChangeDistance) ..
                                " inches. Pick up again to rotate (NO MOVEMENT) [-]")
                        else
                            courseChangePhase = 1
                            courseChangeDistance = 0
                            courseChangeReminderActive = false
                            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                        end
                    else
                        -- Finished rotate-only stage
                        courseChangePhase = 1
                        courseChangeDistance = 0
                        courseChangeReminderActive = false
                        cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                    end

        else
            -- VECTORED + Course Change: Phase 1 (leg1 move) -> Phase 2 (leg2 move) -> Phase 3 (rotate only) -> reset
            if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                            -- Record leg 1 distance (allow 0 for "bend early" play)
                            courseChangeDistance = math.max(0, movedDistance)
                            courseChangePhase = 2
                            courseChangeReminderActive = false  -- Not yet at rotate phase
                            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                            print("[22AA22]Course Change (Vectored): Leg 1 complete - " ..
                                string.format("%.1f", courseChangeDistance) ..
                                "\" moved. Pick up again for Vectored leg 2 [-]")

                        elseif courseChangePhase == 2 then
                            -- Completed leg 2, now go to rotate-only
                            courseChangePhase = 3
                            courseChangeReminderActive = true
                            generateCourseChangeGuideLines()
                            print("[FFAA00]Course Change (Vectored): Leg 2 complete. Pick up again to rotate (NO MOVEMENT) [-]")

                        else
                            -- Completed rotate-only
                            courseChangePhase = 1
                            courseChangeDistance = 0
                            courseChangeReminderActive = false
                            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                        end
        end
    end

    -- VECTORED: after phase 1 drop, lock in leg 1 distance and require a second pickup for the remainder.
    -- After phase 2 drop, reset back to phase 1 for next movement.
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if Vectored and activeOrder ~= "CourseChange" then
        if vectoredPhase == 1 then
            -- Record how far we moved on leg 1 (in inches)
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local diffX = currentPos.x - pivotPosition.x
            local diffZ = currentPos.z - pivotPosition.z
            local movedDistance = math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffZ * diffZ) / UNIT_SCALE

            -- Store even if it is 0 (turn-at-start use case)
            vectoredLeg1Distance = math.max(0, movedDistance)
            vectoredPhase = 2

            print("[22AA22]Vectored: Phase 1 complete - " ..
                string.format("%.1f", vectoredLeg1Distance) ..
                "\" moved. Pick up again for extra bend + remaining move [-]")
            broadcastToAll("First part of vectored move complete, Move again to complete move", {1, 0.67, 0})
            vectoredReminderActive = true
            Sync()

        elseif vectoredPhase == 2 then
            vectoredPhase = 1
            vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
            vectoredReminderActive = false
            Sync()
        end
    end

    -- ORBIT RECOVERY: restore original thrust after one move post-atmosphere exit
    if orbitRecoveryPending then
        orbitRecoveryPending = false
        local shipName = self.getName() or "Unknown Ship"
        local restoredThrust = preAtmosphereThrust or ShipThrust
        ShipThrust = restoredThrust
        preAtmosphereThrust = nil
        print("[22AA22]" .. shipName .. " has successfully reached orbit, it's thrust is now " .. ShipThrust .. "\"[-]")
        Sync()
    end

    -- Update visuals based on Aura state
    updateAuraVisuals()
end

function updateRadialMovement(player)
    local pointerPos = player.getPointerPosition()

    -- Get movement parameters based on active special order
    local MIN_RANGE, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC, MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC = getMovementParameters()

    -- 1. Calculate Direction and Distance
    local diffX = pointerPos.x - pivotPosition.x
    local diffZ = pointerPos.z - pivotPosition.z
    local directionVec = Vector(diffX, 0, diffZ)
    local currentDist = directionVec:magnitude()

    -- 2. Deadzone / Movement Threshold Check
    if currentDist < MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD * UNIT_SCALE then
        self.setPosition(pivotPosition)
        self.setRotation(startRotation)
        self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
        self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

        currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition

        updateAuraVisuals()
        return
    end

    -- 3. Calculate Direction & Clamp Angle
    local moveDir = directionVec:normalized()

    -- Calculate angle difference between Start Forward and Current Direction
    local angleDiff = Vector.angle(startForwardVec, moveDir)

    -- Check if angle exceeds limit (use dynamic max turn angle)
    if angleDiff > MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC then
        local cross = startForwardVec:cross(moveDir)
        local sign = 1
        if cross.y < 0 then sign = -1 end
        moveDir = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', sign * MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
    end

    -- 4. Calculate New Position with MIN and MAX range
    local targetPos  -- Declare here so it's available throughout the function

      -- Special handling for Course Change order
      local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"

      -- Decide if this phase is "rotate-only"
      local rotateOnly = false
      if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
          if Vectored then
              -- Vectored Course Change: Phase 3 is rotate-only
              rotateOnly = (courseChangePhase == 3)
          else
              -- Normal Course Change: Phase 2 is rotate-only
              rotateOnly = (courseChangePhase == 2)
          end
      end

      if activeOrder == "CourseChange" and rotateOnly then
          -- Rotate-only stage: NO MOVEMENT
          targetPos = pivotPosition
      else
          -- Standard clamping (includes Course Change phase 1 and vectored phase 2)
          local currentDistInches = currentDist / UNIT_SCALE
          local clampDistInches = math.max(MIN_RANGE, math.min(currentDistInches, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC))
          local clampDist = clampDistInches * UNIT_SCALE
          targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
      end


    -- Preserve the object's current height
    local currentHandPos = self.getPosition()
    targetPos.y = currentHandPos.y

    -- Smooth interpolation
    if currentSmoothedPos == nil then currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition end
    currentSmoothedPos = currentSmoothedPos:lerp(targetPos, Time.delta_time * SMOOTH_SPEED)
    currentSmoothedPos.y = targetPos.y
    self.setPosition(currentSmoothedPos)

    -- 5. Calculate Rotation
    local targetAngle = moveDir:heading("y")
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        targetAngle = targetAngle - 90
    end
    self.setRotation(Vector(0, targetAngle, 0))

    -- 6. Physics Cleanup
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

    -- 7. Visual Feedback
    local finalLines = {}

    -- Add Aura visuals if enabled (firing arcs + scan)
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
                    for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
                end
            end

            if (state.conditions.Launch or 0) > 0 and cachedLaunchLines then
                for _, l in ipairs(cachedLaunchLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
            end

        if DRAW_RAIL_LINE then
        local visualDir = moveDir
        local shipOffset = currentSmoothedPos - pivotPosition
        shipOffset.y = 0

        if shipOffset:magnitude() > 0.1 then
             visualDir = shipOffset:normalized()
        end

        -- Use dynamic max range for visual
        local railEnd = pivotPosition + (visualDir * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        local localStart = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
        localStart.y = localStart.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localEnd = self.positionToLocal(railEnd)
        localEnd.y = localEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Use dynamic max turn angle for limit lines
        local leftLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
        local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)

        local leftLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)
        local rightLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        -- COURSE CHANGE PHASE 2 ROTATION GUIDES
        -- Draw short 5" guide lines so players can visualise the allowed rotation when range is 0
        if activeOrder == "CourseChange" and ((not Vectored and courseChangePhase == 2) or (Vectored and courseChangePhase == 3)) then
            local guideLen = 5 * UNIT_SCALE

            local leftGuideEndWorld  = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec  * guideLen)
            local rightGuideEndWorld = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * guideLen)

            local localLeftGuideEnd  = self.positionToLocal(leftGuideEndWorld)
            localLeftGuideEnd.y = localLeftGuideEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

            local localRightGuideEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightGuideEndWorld)
            localRightGuideEnd.y = localRightGuideEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localLeftGuideEnd },
                color = {1, 1, 1},
                thickness = 0.08,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localRightGuideEnd },
                color = {1, 1, 1},
                thickness = 0.08,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end


        local localLeftEnd = self.positionToLocal(leftLimitEnd)
        localLeftEnd.y = localLeftEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localRightEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightLimitEnd)
        localRightEnd.y = localRightEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Main range line (white)
        table.insert(finalLines, {
            points = { localStart, localEnd },
            color = {1, 1, 1},
            thickness = 0.1,
            rotation = {0,0,0}
        })

        -- Only draw turn limit lines if turning is allowed
        if MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC > 0 then
            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localLeftEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localRightEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end

        -- Draw minimum range circle if MIN_RANGE > 0
        if MIN_RANGE > 0 then
            local minCirclePoints = {}
            local segments = 32
            local step = 360 / segments
            for i = 0, segments do
                local angle = math.rad(i * step)
                local x = math.cos(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local z = math.sin(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local worldPos = pivotPosition + Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z)
                table.insert(minCirclePoints, self.positionToLocal(worldPos))
            end

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = minCirclePoints,
                color = {1, 1, 0},  -- Yellow for minimum range
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function generateSignatureLines()
    cachedSignatureLines = {}

    if not state.sigAuraShown or state.sig == 0 then
        return  -- Don't generate if not shown or sig is 0
    end

    local circleColor = {0.8, 0, 0}  -- Red for signature

    -- Calculate signature radius
    local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local sigRadius = state.sig * UNIT_SCALE / scale

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * sigRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * sigRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedSignatureLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15  -- Slightly thicker than scan lines
    })
end

function generateLaunchLines()
    cachedLaunchLines = {}

    local circleColor = {1, 0.6, 0}  -- Orange for launch range

    local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local launchRadius = 6 * UNIT_SCALE / scale  -- 6 inches

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * launchRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * launchRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedLaunchLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15
    })
end

function getMovementParameters()
    if not ShipThrust or ShipThrust == 0 then
        ShipThrust = 9
    end

    -- NAVIGATION OFFLINE: hard cap 2", no turning
    if (state.conditions.Navigation_Offline or 0) > 0 then
        return 0, 2, 0
    end

    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    local halfThrust = ShipThrust / 2
    local fullThrust = ShipThrust
    local doubleThrust = ShipThrust * 2

    -- Base parameters for the current order
    local baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn

    if activeOrder == "GeneralQuarters" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 45

    elseif activeOrder == "SilentRunningOrder" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "WeaponsFree" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

      elseif activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
          -- COURSE CHANGE:
          -- Normal ship: Phase 1 = move up to half thrust, Phase 2 = rotate only
          -- Vectored ship: Phase 1 = move leg 1, Phase 2 = move leg 2 (vectored bend), Phase 3 = rotate only

          if Vectored then
              if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                  -- Leg 1: up to half thrust
                  return 0, halfThrust, 45
              elseif courseChangePhase == 2 then
                  -- Leg 2: remaining distance up to half thrust, allow bend (45)
                  local leg1 = courseChangeDistance or 0
                  local remainingMax = math.max(0, halfThrust - leg1)
                  return 0, remainingMax, 45
              else
                  -- Phase 3: rotate only, no movement
                  return 0, 0, 45
              end
          else
              -- Normal non-vectored Course Change behaviour (your original)
              if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                  return 0, halfThrust, 45
              else
                  return 0, 0, 45
              end
          end


    elseif activeOrder == "MaxThrust" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = fullThrust, doubleThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "DamageControl" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = 0, halfThrust, 45

    else
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 45
    end

    -- VECTORED override (applies to any order except CourseChange)
    if Vectored and activeOrder ~= "CourseChange" then
        if vectoredPhase == 1 then
            -- Leg 1: MIN disabled, so you can do 0 move then bend at start
            return 0, baseMax, baseTurn

        elseif vectoredPhase == 2 then
            -- Leg 2: remaining distance, and MIN enforced by total (leg1 + leg2)
            local remainingMax = math.max(0, baseMax - (vectoredLeg1Distance or 0))
            local remainingMin = math.max(0, baseMin - (vectoredLeg1Distance or 0))

            -- Extra bend allowance: at least 45° for leg 2, even if baseTurn is 0
            local turn2 = math.max(baseTurn or 0, 45)

            return remainingMin, remainingMax, turn2
        end
    end

    -- Default: base order params
    return baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn
end


function updateAuraVisuals()
    local finalLines = {}

    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if state.sigAuraShown and cachedSignatureLines then
                for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
            end

        if (state.conditions.Launch or 0) > 0 and cachedLaunchLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedLaunchLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end

        -- Persistent course change rotation guides (always generated from current position)
            if courseChangeReminderActive then
                local guideLen = 5 * UNIT_SCALE

                -- Determine the ship's current forward vector
                local currentForward
                if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
                    currentForward = self.getTransformRight()
                else
                    currentForward = self.getTransformForward()
                end
                currentForward.y = 0
                currentForward:normalize()

                local leftLimitVec  = currentForward:copy():rotateOver('y', -45)
                local rightLimitVec = currentForward:copy():rotateOver('y',  45)

                local shipPos = self.getPosition()
                local origin  = Vector(shipPos.x, shipPos.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET, shipPos.z)

                local leftEnd  = origin + (leftLimitVec  * guideLen)
                local rightEnd = origin + (rightLimitVec * guideLen)

                local localOrigin = self.positionToLocal(origin)
                local localLeft   = self.positionToLocal(leftEnd)
                local localRight  = self.positionToLocal(rightEnd)

                table.insert(finalLines, {
                    points    = { localOrigin, localLeft },
                    color     = {1, 1, 1},
                    thickness = 0.08,
                    rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
                })
                table.insert(finalLines, {
                    points    = { localOrigin, localRight },
                    color     = {1, 1, 1},
                    thickness = 0.08,
                    rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
                })
            end

        self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state = state or {}
    state.health = state.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}

    local prevHP = tonumber(state.health.current) or 0

    -- Apply health change (clamped)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, (state.health.current or 0) + (params.amount or 0)))

    -- Update the health bar UI
    SyncHealth()

    -- If HP just reached 0, force Free Movement ON
    if prevHP > 0 and state.health.current == 0 then
        if (state.conditions.MoveOff or 0) == 0 then
            state.conditions.MoveOff = 1

            -- Free move disables vectored sequencing entirely (match your existing MoveOff behaviour)
            vectoredPhase = 1
            vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
            vectoredReminderActive = false

            -- Optional: also clear course change reminder/guides so nothing keeps drawing
            courseChangePhase = 1
            courseChangeDistance = 0
            courseChangeReminderActive = false
            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil

            print("[FF4444]" .. (self.getName() or "Ship") .. " reduced to 0 HP, Free Movement enabled.[-]")

            -- Update the MoveOff button visuals immediately
            SyncCondition("MoveOff")
        end
    end
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus

    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)

    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig

        -- Regenerate signature lines if they're being shown
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            generateSignatureLines()
            updateAuraVisuals()
            print("Signature updated to: " .. state.sig .. " inches")

-- Update the ModifyCondition function to handle fractionNumber wrapping (0-9)
function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            -- Special handling for FractionNumber
            if params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                -- Increment or decrement and wrap around 0-9
                local newValue = (previousValue + params.amount) % 10
                if newValue < 0 then newValue = 9 end  -- Handle negative wrap-around
                state.conditions[params.name] = newValue
                state.fractionNumber = newValue  -- Update the state variable
            else
                state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
            end
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        if params.name ~= "MoveNumber" and params.name ~= "FractionNumber" then
            print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        else
            if params.name == "MoveNumber" then
                state.moveNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            elseif params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                state.fractionNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            end
        end
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);

    local conditionData = Conditions[name]
    if not conditionData then
        print("SyncCondition: Unknown condition '" .. tostring(name) .. "'")
        return
    end

    for _, color in ipairs(getConnectedColors()) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0

        -- Special handling for Status button - show active if any critical status is active
        local isActive
        if name == "Status" then
            isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
            state.conditions.Status = isActive and 1 or 0
        else
            isActive = conditionValue > 0
        end

        local imageUrl
        local colorBlock
        if name == "MoveOff" then
            local moveCond = Conditions["MoveOff"]
            imageUrl = isActive and (moveCond.active_url or moveCond.url) or moveCond.url
            colorBlock = isActive and "#00FF00FF" or "#000000FF"
        else
            imageUrl = isActive and (conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url) or conditionData.url
            if currentUIMode == 0 then
                colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. "FF"
            else
                colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. (isActive and "FF" or "22")
            end
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and "true" or "false",
            text = tostring(conditionValue)
        })

        ApplyActivatedLockState()

function getConnectedColors()
    -- Refresh at most once per second (60 frames)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastPlayerColorCheck < 1 then
        return cachedPlayerColors
    end
    lastPlayerColorCheck = now

    local colors = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if UIStatus[player.color] then

    -- Fallback to all if somehow empty (e.g. during load)

        cachedPlayerColors = {'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}

    end
    return cachedPlayerColors

function ui()
    local panelContent = ""

    for _, color in ipairs({'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}) do
        -- Generate ship card panel for this player if needed
        local shipCardPanel = ""
        if state.conditions.ShipCard > 0 then
            shipCardPanel = generateShipCardPanel()
        end

        -- Generate upgrade prompt if pending
        local upgradePrompt = ""
        if pendingUpgrade then
            upgradePrompt = generateUpgradePromptPanel()
        end

        local pivot = PlayerHUDPivot(color, shipCardPanel .. upgradePrompt)
        if pivot then
            panelContent = panelContent .. pivot
        end
    end

    -- Generate fixed image panel ONLY if 3D model is NOT showing
    local fixedImagePanel = ""
    if not Model3DAvailable then
        fixedImagePanel = generateFixedImagePanel("Blue")
    end

    local result = [[
        <Panel color="#FFFFFFff" height="0" width="0" rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="true" >]]
        .. panelContent
        .. fixedImagePanel  -- Will be empty string if 3D model is showing
        .. [[</Panel>
    ]]
    return result
end

function rebuildAssets()
    local assets = {};

    -- Select backdrop URL based on player color
    local backdropURL = BACKDROP_URLS[playerColor] or BACKDROP_URLS["Blue"]
    assets[#assets + 1] = { name = "UIBackdrop", url = backdropURL };
    assets[#assets + 1] = { name = "StatusDropdown", url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/UI/SHIPUI/DropdownMenu.png" };
    assets[#assets + 1] = { name = "RightMenu", url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TemporalDistoriton/DropfleetTTS/main/Assets/UI/SHIPUI/RightMenu.png" };

    for conditionName, value in pairs(Conditions) do
        assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName, url = value.url };
        if value.active_url then
            assets[#assets + 1] = { name = conditionName .. "_active", url = value.active_url };
        end
    end

    self.UI.setCustomAssets(assets)
end

function PlayerHUDPivot(color, additionalContent)
    if not UIStatus[color] then
        return ""
    end

    -- In deploy mode, show only the "Finish Deploy" button instead of the full HUD
    if deployMode then
        local deployBtn = generateDeployButton(color)
        return string.format([[
            <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 0' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
            %s
            </Panel>
        ]], color, color, deployBtn)
    end

    local content = getUIContent(color)
    if not content then
        return ""
    end

    local extraContent = additionalContent or ""

    local result = string.format([[
        <Panel id='%s_PlayerHUDPivot' visibility='%s' height="260" width="100" position='0 0 -340' rotation='0 0 270' rectAlignment="MiddleCenter" childForceExpandWidth="false">
        %s
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], color, color, content, extraContent)
    return result
end

function getUIContent(color)
    if currentUIMode == 0 then
        return HighVisibilityUI(color, BigUI_Height)
    else
        return SubtleUI(color, BigUI_Height)
    end
end

        HUDSingleCondition(color, "WeaponsFree", LeftRef+1, 0.5, size/2),
    }

    -- Only show Course Change and Max Thrust if NOT a Monitor

        table.insert(orderButtons, HUDSingleCondition(color, "CourseChange", LeftRef+1, -0.5, size/2))
        table.insert(orderButtons, HUDSingleCondition(color, "MaxThrust", LeftRef+2, 0.5, size/2))

-- Static Tooltip Handlers
function UI_ShowTooltip(player, value, id)
    local name = id:match("ConditionFrame_(.+)")
    if name then
        local text = TOOLTIPS[name] or name
        local tooltipID = player.color .. "_StaticTooltip"
        self.UI.setAttribute(tooltipID, "text", text)
        self.UI.setAttribute(tooltipID, "active", "true")
    end
end

function UI_HideTooltip(player, value, id)
    local tooltipID = player.color .. "_StaticTooltip"
    self.UI.setAttribute(tooltipID, "text", "")
    self.UI.setAttribute(tooltipID, "active", "false")
end

function UI_ShowHealthTooltip(player, value, id)
    local tooltipID = player.color .. "_StaticTooltip"
    self.UI.setAttribute(tooltipID, "text", "Left/Right click to adjust health")
    self.UI.setAttribute(tooltipID, "active", "true")

function HUDSingleConditionRectangular(color, name, x, y, width, height)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not width or not height then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (height + 4) * UI_SCALE) - (1.5 * height + 4) * UI_SCALE), y * ((height + 4) * UI_SCALE))

    return string.format([[
        <Panel id="%s" width="%d" height="%d" alignment='LowerLeft' position='%s' onClick='UI_Modify%s()' onMouseEnter='UI_ShowTooltip' onMouseExit='UI_HideTooltip'>
        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, width * UI_SCALE, height * UI_SCALE, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBodyRectangular(color, name, width * UI_SCALE, height * UI_SCALE) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBodyRectangular(color, name, width, height)
    if not color or not name or not width or not height or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end

    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end

    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local isActive
    if name == "Status" then
        isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
    else
        isActive = conditionValue > 0
    end
    local imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url

    -- Match the logic from HUDSingleConditionBody exactly
    local colorBlock
    if currentUIMode == 0 then  -- High Visibility mode - always fully opaque
        colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"
    else  -- Subtle mode (1) - transparent when inactive
        colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive and 'FF' or '22')
    end

    local fontSize = math.floor(height * 0.85)

    local displayText = name == "Move" and "Move" or tostring(conditionValue)

    return string.format([[
        <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
        <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
    ]],
    color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, width, height,
    color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and isActive), fontSize, displayText, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function SelectSpecialOrder(orderName)
    local wasOnSilentRunning = (state.activeSpecialOrder == "SilentRunningOrder")

    state.activeSpecialOrder = orderName
    state.specialOrdersMenuOpen = false
    state.conditions.SpecialOrders = 0

    -- Reset phases
    courseChangePhase = 1
    courseChangeDistance = 0
    courseChangeReminderActive = false
    cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
    vectoredPhase = 1
    vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
    vectoredReminderActive = false

    -- Silent Running state
    if orderName == "SilentRunningOrder" then
        state.conditions.Silent_Running = 1
        cloaked = 1
        RecalculateSignature()
        SyncCondition("Silent_Running")
    elseif wasOnSilentRunning then
        state.conditions.Silent_Running = 0
        cloaked = 0
        RecalculateSignature()
        SyncCondition("Silent_Running")
    end

    -- THIS is the missing piece for the “stuck” graphics:
    SyncSpecialOrderVisuals(orderName)
    UpdateSpecialOrdersIcon()
    Sync()
end

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then
        return ""
    end
    local id = "ConditionFrame_" .. name
    local position = string.format("%s %s 0", ((x * (size + 4) * UI_SCALE) - (1.5 * size + 4) * UI_SCALE), y * ((size + 4) * UI_SCALE))

    return string.format([[

        %s
        </Panel>
    ]], id, size * UI_SCALE, size * UI_SCALE, position, name, HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size * UI_SCALE) or "")
end

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end

    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end

    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0

    local imageUrl
    if name == "MoveOff" then
        local moveCond = Conditions["MoveOff"]
        imageUrl = isActive and (moveCond.active_url or moveCond.url) or moveCond.url
    else
        imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    end

    local colorBlock
    if name == "MoveOff" then
        colorBlock = (isActive and "#00FF00FF" or "#ffffff")
    else
        if currentUIMode == 0 then
            colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"
        else
            local isActive2 = (state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0
            colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive2 and 'FF' or '22')
        end
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85 * 2)

    local displayText = name == "Move" and "Move" or tostring(state.conditions[name] or 0)

    return string.format([[

function UI_ModifyAtmosphere(p, alt_click)
    -- Block orbital layer change while Navigation is offline
    if (state.conditions.Navigation_Offline or 0) > 0 then
        broadcastToAll("Cannot change Orbital Layer — Navigation Offline!", {1, 0.4, 0.4})
        return
    end

    local wasInAtmosphere = (state.conditions.Atmosphere or 0) > 0

    UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Atmosphere")

    local nowInAtmosphere = (state.conditions.Atmosphere or 0) > 0
    local shipName = self.getName() or "Unknown Ship"

    if nowInAtmosphere and not wasInAtmosphere then
        -- Entering atmosphere
        preAtmosphereThrust = ShipThrust
        orbitRecoveryPending = false
        ShipThrust = 2
        print("[4488FF]" .. shipName .. " has entered Atmosphere! Thrust locked to 2\" (was " .. preAtmosphereThrust .. "\")[-]")

    elseif not nowInAtmosphere and wasInAtmosphere then
        -- Exiting atmosphere
        if preAtmosphereThrust then
            local penaltyThrust = math.max(0, preAtmosphereThrust - 4)
            orbitRecoveryPending = true
            ShipThrust = penaltyThrust
            print("[FFAA00]" .. shipName .. " is rising to orbit and loses 4\" of Thrust, It's thrust is currently " .. penaltyThrust .. "\" for it's next move[-]")
        else
            -- Safety fallback (shouldn't normally hit this)
            orbitRecoveryPending = false
        end
    end

    Sync()
end

-- Update the UI_ModifyMove function to use fractional movement
function UI_ModifyMove(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            if not self.getLock() then
                self.setLock(true)
            end

            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local directionMultiplier = alt == '-2' and -1 or 1

            local deltaX = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local newPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            self.setPosition(newPos)

            local direction = directionMultiplier == 1 and "forward" or "backward"
            local modelName = self.getName()

            local colorCode = directionMultiplier == 1 and "22AA22" or "AA2222"
            print(modelName .. " has moved " ..
                "[" .. colorCode .. "]" .. direction .. "[-][F4641D] " ..
                string.format("%.1f", moveAmount) .. "[-] inches ")

            showMeasurementLine()
        end
    end
end

function ToggleProjectedArcs()
    local isProjected = state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0

    if isProjected then
        ProjectArcsForward()
        print("[22AA22] Projecting ship arcs [-]")
    else
        ResetArcs()
        print("[AA2222] Resetting ship arcs [-]")
    end
end

function ProjectArcsForward()
    if state._projectingArcs then return end
    state._projectingArcs = true

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0, a = 0.6})

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end

    state._projectingArcs = false
end

function ResetArcs()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())

        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint(clr)

        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                end
            end
        ]])
    end
end

function RoundReset()
    -- Nuke anything currently drawn
    ClearAllMovementLines()

    -- reset activation
    state.conditions.Activated = 0
    SyncCondition("Activated")

    -- Reset special orders to General Quarters, EXCEPT Silent Running which persists across rounds
    local onSilentRunning = (state.activeSpecialOrder == "SilentRunningOrder")
    if not onSilentRunning then
        state.activeSpecialOrder = "GeneralQuarters"
        state.specialOrdersMenuOpen = false
        state.conditions.SpecialOrders = 0
        -- reset order condition flags (if you rely on these icons)
        SyncSpecialOrderVisuals("GeneralQuarters")
        UpdateSpecialOrdersIcon()
    end

    -- >>> THIS IS THE IMPORTANT BIT <<<
    -- Clear course-change / vectored “reminder” state so guides cannot be redrawn
    courseChangePhase = 1
    courseChangeDistance = 0
    courseChangeReminderActive = false
    cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil

    vectoredPhase = 1
    vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
    vectoredReminderActive = false

    -- If you want aura/sig visuals to remain after wiping lines, rebuild them cleanly
    updateAuraVisuals()

    -- Rebuild UI
    Sync()
end

function showMeasurementLine()
    local ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER = 0.5
    local ARROW_WIDTH = 1.05
    local ARROW_HEIGHT = 1
    local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = 0
    local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = 0
    local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = 270
    local ARROW_COLOR = {r=0, g=1, b=0, a=0.7}
    local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION = {0, 0, 0}

    local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
    local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
    local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

    if moveAmount > 0 then
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
        local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

        local currentPos = self.getPosition()

        local arrowPos = {
            x = currentPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
            y = currentPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
            z = currentPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
        }

        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setPosition(arrowPos)
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1],
                rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
            })
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, moveAmount * ARROW_WIDTH})
        else
            ChildObjs.measurement_line = spawnObject({
                type = 'Custom_Model',
                position = arrowPos,
                rotation = {
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1],
                    rotation.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3]
                },
                scale = {ARROW_LENGTH_MULTIPLIER, ARROW_HEIGHT, ARROW_WIDTH},
                mass = 0,
                use_gravity = false,
                sound = false,
                snap_to_grid = false,
                callback_function = function(obj)
                    obj.setColorTint(ARROW_COLOR)
                    obj.setVar('parent', self)
                    obj.setLuaScript([[
                        local ARROW_Y_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_Y_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET = ]] .. ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[1] .. [[
                        local ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z = ]] .. ADDITIONAL_ROTATION[3] .. [[

                        function onUpdate()
                            if parent and parent.getPosition then
                                local shipPos = parent.getPosition()
                                local shipRot = parent.getRotation()

                                local shipAngle = math.rad(shipRot.y)
                                local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

                                local arrowPos = {
                                    x = shipPos.x + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.sin(moveAngle),
                                    y = shipPos.y + ARROW_Y_OFFSET,
                                    z = shipPos.z + ARROW_FORWARD_OFFSET * math.cos(moveAngle)
                                }

                                self.setPosition(arrowPos)
                                self.setRotation({
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_X,
                                    shipRot.y + ARROW_ROTATION_OFFSET,
                                    ADDITIONAL_ROTATION_Z
                                })
                            end
                        end
                    ]])
                    obj.getComponent('MeshRenderer').set('receiveShadows', false)
                end
            })

            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setCustomObject({
                mesh = 'https://steamusercontent-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/9677217278061704/57037684E623F5E07758B8F6811F78DD224C8668/',
                collider = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/RobMayer/TTSLibrary/master/utility/null_COL.obj',
                type = 0,
                material = 3,
                specularIntensity = 0.1,
                cast_shadows = false
            })
        end
    else
        if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setScale({0, 0, 0})
        end
    end
end

local function _xmlEscape(s)
    s = tostring(s or "")
    s = s:gsub("&", "&"):gsub("<", "<"):gsub(">", ">"):gsub('"', """):gsub("'", "'")
    return s
end

local function _normaliseSummaryForLog(summary)
    summary = tostring(summary or "")
    -- Replace unicode arrows with safer ASCII (TTS fonts sometimes render unicode inconsistently)
    summary = summary:gsub("→", "->")
    return summary
end

local function AddUpgradeLogEntry(upgradeName, summary)
    -- Ensure container exists
    state = state or {}
    state.upgradeLog = state.upgradeLog or {}

    local line = tostring(upgradeName or "Unknown Upgrade") .. ": " .. _normaliseSummaryForLog(summary)
    table.insert(state.upgradeLog, line)

    -- Keep log bounded so it cannot grow forever
    local MAX_LOG_LINES = 30
    while #state.upgradeLog > MAX_LOG_LINES do
        table.remove(state.upgradeLog, 1)
    end
end

ObjectStates.LuaScript:
--==============================================================================
-- CONFIGURATION
--==============================================================================
--==============================================================================
-- FACTION AUTO-DETECT (from object name)
-- Expected object name format: "Faction ABC" (ABC = 3-letter code)
--==============================================================================


local function asciiLower3(s)
    -- Lowercase A-Z only, safe on any bytes
    if type(s) ~= "string" then return "" end
    return (s:gsub("%u", function(c) return string.char(c:byte() + 32) end))
end

local function detectFactionFromObjectName(obj)
    local name = ""
    if obj and obj.getName then
        local ok, result = pcall(function() return obj.getName() end)
        if ok and type(result) == "string" then name = result end
    end

    -- Extract the 3 letters after "Faction" without calling string.lower on the whole name
    -- Accepts: "Faction PHR", "Faction: PHR", "Faction - PHR"
    local code = name:match("[Ff][Aa][Cc][Tt][Ii][Oo][Nn]%s*[:%-]?%s*(%a%a%a)")
    if not code then return nil end

    code = asciiLower3(code)

    local map = {
        phr = "phr",
        sco = "scourge",
        res = "resistance",
        sha = "shaltari",
        ucm = "ucm",
        bio = "bioficers",
        civ = "civilian",
        ind = "industrial",
    }

    return map[code]
end


-- Decide faction key now
local autoFaction = detectFactionFromObjectName(self) or "civilian"  -- default fallback

CONFIG = {
    -- Faction name (used in broadcasts and UI title)
    FACTION_NAME = autoFaction,
    -- UI appearance settings
      UI = {
          -- Main panel dimensions
          PANEL_WIDTH = 720,
          PANEL_HEIGHT = 820,

          -- Colors
          PANEL_COLOR = "rgba(0.1, 0.1, 0.15, 1)",
          TAB_COLOR = "rgba(0.2, 0.2, 0.3, 1)",
          TAB_SELECTED_COLOR = "rgba(0.4, 0.4, 0.6, 1)",
          CARD_COLOR = "rgba(0.25, 0.25, 0.35, 1)",
          CARD_SELECTED_COLOR = "rgba(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1)",
          BUTTON_COLOR = "rgba(0.3, 0.5, 0.8, 1)",
          CLOSE_BUTTON_COLOR = "rgba(0.8, 0.2, 0.2, 1)",
          TEXT_COLOR = "#FFFFFF",
          SEARCH_BG_COLOR = "rgba(0.15, 0.15, 0.2, 1)",

          -- Element size controls
          SEARCH_ROW_HEIGHT = 28,
          SEARCH_INPUT_WIDTH = 200,
          CLEAR_BUTTON_WIDTH = 100,
          CLEAR_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 28,
          CLOSE_BUTTON_WIDTH = 28,
          CLOSE_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 28,
          TABS_ROW_HEIGHT = 26,
          ARROW_BUTTON_WIDTH = 50,
          SPAWN_BUTTON_HEIGHT = 45,

          -- Font sizes
          FONT_SIZE_SEARCH = 13,
          FONT_SIZE_TABS = 18,
          FONT_SIZE_CLASS_TABS = 12,
          FONT_SIZE_ARROWS = 60,
          FONT_SIZE_SPAWN = 32,
          FONT_SIZE_CLOSE = 14,

          -- Tooltip sizing
          TOOLTIP_WIDTH = 600,
          TOOLTIP_HEIGHT = 90,
          TOOLTIP_FONT_SIZE = 29,
      },

      -- Player spawn positions
      PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS = {
          ["Red"] = {
              position = {x = -32.82, y = 1.20 , z = 15.77},
              rotation = {x = 0, y = 270, z = 0},
              direction = {x = 0, y = 0, z = -1.9},
          },
          ["Blue"] = {
              position = {x = 32.82, y = 1.20 , z = -15.77},
              rotation = {x = 0, y = 90, z = 0},
              direction = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 1.9},
          },
      },

      -- Spacing between spawned cards
      CARD_SPAWN_SPACING = 2.92,

      -- Number of cards per row before wrapping to next row
      CARDS_PER_ROW = 6,

      -- Class categories (ship class/type sorting)
      CLASS_CATEGORIES = {
          "Other", "Cell", "Corvette", "Lighter", "Frigate", "Carrier", "Monitor",
          "Cutter", "Destroyer", "Runner", "Light Cruiser", "Cruiser", "Heavy Cruiser",
          "Troopship", "Battlecruiser", "Battleship", "Supercarrier", "Super Battleship",
          "Dreadnaught"
      },

      -- Tonnage categories (ship size/weight sorting based on ShipbaseSize)
      TONNAGE_CATEGORIES = {"Light", "Medium", "Heavy", "Colossal"},

      -- ShipbaseSize to Tonnage mapping
      SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE = {
          [30] = "Light",
          [40] = "Medium",
          [50] = "Heavy",
          [60] = "Colossal",
      }
  }

  --==============================================================================
  -- STATE VARIABLES
  --==============================================================================

  savedShipCards = {}
  savedShipCardsBackup = {}
  playerSelections = {}
  playerCardIndices = {}
  playerSearchFilters = {}
  playerActiveTabs = {}
  playerActiveTonnageTabs = {}
  playerSpawnCounts = {}
  playerListInputs = {}
  playerListUIVisible = {}
  playerListInputText = {}
  fresh = true
  selfGUID = ""

  -- Shared (everyone sees the same UI)
  sharedShipUIOpen = false

  sharedSearchFilter = ""
  sharedActiveTab = nil
  sharedActiveTonnageTab = nil
  sharedCardIndex = 1

  --==============================================================================
  -- SAVE/LOAD FUNCTIONS
  --==============================================================================

  function updateSave()
          local script = self.getLuaScript()

          -- Find where the embedded data section starts
          local dataStartPattern = "\n%-%-EMBEDDED_DATA_START"
          local dataStart = script:find(dataStartPattern)

          if dataStart then
              script = script:sub(1, dataStart - 1)
          end

          -- Build the embedded data section
          local embeddedData = "\n--EMBEDDED_DATA_START\n"
          embeddedData = embeddedData .. "savedShipCards = {\n"

          for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  {\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    name = [====[" .. (card.name or "Unknown") .. "]====],\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    imageURL = [====[" .. (card.imageURL or "") .. "]====],\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    tonnage = [====[" .. (card.tonnage or "Light") .. "]====],\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    shipTonnage = [====[" .. (card.shipTonnage or "Light") .. "]====],\n"
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    baseScale = " .. (card.baseScale or 1) .. ",\n"
              if card.json then
                  embeddedData = embeddedData .. "    json = [====[" .. card.json .. "]====],\n"
              end
              embeddedData = embeddedData .. "  },\n"
          end

          embeddedData = embeddedData .. "}\n\n"
          embeddedData = embeddedData .. "fresh = " .. tostring(fresh) .. "\n"

          script = script .. embeddedData
          self.setLuaScript(script)
      end

  function onLoad(saved_data)
          selfGUID = self.getGUID()

          -- Initialize variables if they don't exist
          if savedShipCards == nil then
              savedShipCards = {}
          end
          if fresh == nil then
              fresh = true
          end

          -- Update fresh status based on data
          if #savedShipCards > 0 then
              fresh = false
          end

          -- Initialize player state tables
          playerSelections = {}
          playerCardIndices = {}
          playerSearchFilters = {}
          playerActiveTabs = {}
          playerActiveTonnageTabs = {}
          playerSpawnCounts = {}

          -- Clean loaded data
          for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              if card.json then card.json = stripBrackets(card.json) end
              if card.imageURL then card.imageURL = stripBrackets(card.imageURL) end
          end

          -- Ensure all cards have shipTonnage extracted from their JSON
          ensureShipTonnage()

      -- Show appropriate buttons
      if fresh then
          createSetupButton()
      else
          createMainButtonsWithList()
      end
  end

  --==============================================================================
  -- BUTTON CREATION FUNCTIONS
  --==============================================================================

  function createButton_helper(params)
          local defaults = {
              function_owner = self,
              rotation = {0, 0, 0},
              font_color = {1, 1, 1}
          }

          -- Merge params with defaults
          local buttonConfig = {}
          for k, v in pairs(defaults) do
              buttonConfig[k] = v
          end
          for k, v in pairs(params) do
              buttonConfig[k] = v
          end

      self.createButton(buttonConfig)
  end

  function createSetupButton()
          self.clearButtons()
          self.clearInputs()

          createButton_helper({
              label = "Setup",
              click_function = "buttonClick_setup",
              position = {0, 1, 0},
              height = 350,
              width = 800,
              font_size = 250,
          color = {0.2, 0.2, 0.3}
      })
  end

  function createSetupActionButtons()
          self.clearButtons()
          self.clearInputs()

          -- Compact stacked layout (vertical) — smaller buttons
          local btnHeight = 60
          local btnWidth  = 380
          local btnFont   = 60
          local zStart    = 1.2
          local zSpacing  = -0.25

          -- Cancel button (top)
          createButton_helper({
              label = "Cancel",
              click_function = "buttonClick_cancel",
              position = {0, 1, zStart},
              height = btnHeight,
              width = btnWidth,
              font_size = btnFont,
              color = {0.4, 0.2, 0.2}
          })

          -- Add button (below Cancel)
          createButton_helper({
              label = "Add Ships",
              click_function = "buttonClick_add",
              position = {0, 1, zStart + zSpacing},
              height = btnHeight,
              width = btnWidth,
              font_size = btnFont,
              color = {0.2, 0.5, 0.2}
          })

          -- Remove button (only if cards exist)
          if not fresh then
              createButton_helper({
                  label = "Remove Ships",
                  click_function = "buttonClick_remove",
                  position = {0, 1, zStart + (2 * zSpacing)},
                  height = btnHeight,
                  width = btnWidth,
                  font_size = btnFont,
                  color = {0.5, 0.2, 0.2}
              })
          end

          -- Reset button (bottom)
          createButton_helper({
              label = "Reset",
              click_function = "buttonClick_reset",
              position = {0, 1, zStart + (3 * zSpacing)},
              height = btnHeight,
              width = btnWidth,
              font_size = btnFont,
              color = {0.3, 0.3, 0.3}
          })
      end

  --==============================================================================
  -- SETUP MODE FUNCTIONS
  --==============================================================================

  function buttonClick_setup()
          savedShipCardsBackup = duplicateTable(savedShipCards)
      createSetupActionButtons()
      broadcastToAll("Setup Mode: Box-select ship cards, then click Add/Remove", {1, 1, 1})
  end

  function buttonClick_cancel()
          savedShipCards = savedShipCardsBackup

          if #savedShipCards == 0 then
              createSetupButton()
          else
              createMainButtonsWithList()
          end

      broadcastToAll("Setup Canceled", {1, 1, 1})
  end

  function buttonClick_add(obj, player_color)
          local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
          local count = 0

          for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
              if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() and selectedObj ~= self then
                  -- Check if it's a card or tile
                  if selectedObj.tag == "Card" or selectedObj.tag == "Tile" then
                      -- Check if already saved (by name comparison)
                      local cardName = selectedObj.getName()
                      local alreadyExists = false

                      for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
                          if saved.name == cardName then
                              alreadyExists = true
                              break
                          end
                      end

                      if not alreadyExists then
                          -- Extract card data
                          local cardData = extractCardData(selectedObj)
                          if cardData then
                              table.insert(savedShipCards, cardData)
                              count = count + 1
                          end
                      end
                  end
              end
          end

          if count > 0 then
              fresh = false
              -- Sort cards alphabetically
              sortShipCards()
              updateSave()
              broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) added to " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {0.2, 1, 0.2})
          else
              broadcastToAll("No new cards to add (select Card objects)", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
          end

      createMainButtonsWithList()
  end

  function buttonClick_remove(obj, player_color)
          local selectedObjs = Player[player_color].getSelectedObjects()
          local count = 0

          local newSavedCards = {}

          for _, saved in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              local shouldRemove = false

              for _, selectedObj in ipairs(selectedObjs) do
                  if selectedObj and not selectedObj.isDestroyed() then
                      if selectedObj.getName() == saved.name then
                          shouldRemove = true
                          count = count + 1
                          break
                      end
                  end
              end

              if not shouldRemove then
                  table.insert(newSavedCards, saved)
              end
          end

          savedShipCards = newSavedCards

          if #savedShipCards == 0 then
              fresh = true
              createSetupButton()
          else
              createMainButtonsWithList()
          end

          updateSave()
      broadcastToAll(count .. " ship card(s) removed from " .. CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker", {1, 0.5, 0.5})
  end

  function buttonClick_reset()
          fresh = true
          savedShipCards = {}
          savedShipCardsBackup = {}
          playerSelections = {}
          playerSearchFilters = {}
          playerActiveTabs = {}
          playerSpawnCounts = {}

          createSetupButton()
          updateSave()
      broadcastToAll(CONFIG.FACTION_NAME .. " Ship Picker Reset", {1, 1, 1})
  end

  --==============================================================================
  -- CARD DATA EXTRACTION
  --==============================================================================

  function startsWithBullet(line)
      if not line or #line == 0 then return false end
      -- UTF-8 bullet: compare 3-byte sequence
      if #line >= 3 and line:sub(1, 3) == "\xe2\x80\xa2" then return true end
      -- ASCII fallback bullets
      local c = line:sub(1, 1)
      if c == "-" or c == "*" then return true end
      return false
  end

  -- NEW HELPER: Strip bullet prefix and return trimmed remainder
  function stripBulletPrefix(line)
      if #line >= 3 and line:sub(1, 3) == "\xe2\x80\xa2" then
          return trimString(line:sub(4))
      end
      local c = line:sub(1, 1)
      if c == "-" or c == "*" then
          return trimString(line:sub(2))
      end
      return line
  end

  function extractCardData(cardObj)
          if not cardObj then return nil end

          -- Only allow Tile objects
          if cardObj.tag ~= "Tile" then
              broadcastToAll("Ignored object: Only Tile objects can be saved.", {1, 0.5, 0})
              return nil
          end

          local cardData = {
              name = cardObj.getName() or "Unknown Ship",
              json = nil,
              imageURL = "",
              tonnage = "Light",
              baseScale = 1,
          }

          -- Capture the exact JSON of the object (Tile)
          -- We use this exactly as saved for spawning
          cardData.json = cardObj.getJSON()

          -- Extract Image URL for the UI listing (from CustomObject)
          local customObj = cardObj.getCustomObject()
          if customObj and customObj.image then
              cardData.imageURL = customObj.image
          end

          -- Tonnage detection from Description (check for specific ship types)
          local desc = cardObj.getDescription() or ""
          local descLower = string.lower(desc)
          local name = cardObj.getName() or ""
          nameLower = string.lower(name)

          -- Check both description and name for ship type
          local text = descLower .. " " .. nameLower

          -- Ordered from largest to smallest for proper detection
          if string.find(text, "dreadnought") or string.find(text, "dreadnaught") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Dreadnaught"
          elseif string.find(text, "super battleship") or string.find(text, "superbattleship") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Super Battleship"
          elseif string.find(text, "supercarrier") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Supercarrier"
          elseif string.find(text, "battleship") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Battleship"
          elseif string.find(text, "battlecruiser") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Battlecruiser"
          elseif string.find(text, "troopship") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Troopship"
          elseif string.find(text, "heavy cruiser") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Heavy Cruiser"
          elseif string.find(text, "light cruiser") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Light Cruiser"
          elseif string.find(text, "cruiser") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Cruiser"
          elseif string.find(text, "runner") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Runner"
          elseif string.find(text, "destroyer") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Destroyer"
          elseif string.find(text, "cutter") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Cutter"
          elseif string.find(text, "monitor") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Monitor"
          elseif string.find(text, "carrier") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Carrier"
          elseif string.find(text, "frigate") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Frigate"
          elseif string.find(text, "lighter") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Lighter"
          elseif string.find(text, "corvette") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Corvette"
          elseif string.find(text, "cell") then
              cardData.tonnage = "Cell"
          else
              cardData.tonnage = "Other" -- Default for unrecognized types
          end

          -- Attempt to find baseScale in the Lua script for Tonnage Category sorting
          -- (This preserves the existing logic for categorizing ships in the UI)
          local script = cardObj.getLuaScript()
          if script then
              local scale = script:match("baseScale%s*=%s*([%d%.]+)")
              if scale then
                  cardData.baseScale = tonumber(scale)
              end
          end

          -- Extract ShipbaseSize from the card's JSON to determine ship tonnage
          -- ShipbaseSize is embedded in the ship model's LuaScript within the card JSON
          cardData.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)

      return cardData
  end

  -- Extracts the ship tonnage (Light/Medium/Heavy/Colossal) from a card object's JSON
  -- by finding the ShipbaseSize variable in the embedded ship model LuaScript
  function extractShipTonnageFromObj(cardObj)
      local jsonStr = cardObj.getJSON()
      if jsonStr then
          return extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
      end
      return "Light" -- Default fallback
  end

  -- Extracts the ship tonnage from a raw JSON string by searching for ShipbaseSize
  function extractShipTonnageFromJSON(jsonStr)
      if not jsonStr then return "Light" end
      local shipbaseSize = jsonStr:match("ShipbaseSize%s*=%s*(%d+)")
      if shipbaseSize then
          local size = tonumber(shipbaseSize)
          if CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size] then
              return CONFIG.SHIPBASE_TO_TONNAGE[size]
          end
      end
      return "Light" -- Default fallback
  end

  -- Ensures all savedShipCards have shipTonnage set (backward compat for old embedded data)
  function ensureShipTonnage()
      for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
          if not card.shipTonnage or card.shipTonnage == "" then
              if card.json then
                  card.shipTonnage = extractShipTonnageFromJSON(card.json)
              else
                  card.shipTonnage = "Light"
              end
          end
      end
  end

  function sortShipCards()
          table.sort(savedShipCards, function(a, b)
          return (a.name or "") < (b.name or "")
      end)
  end

  function getFilteredCards(activeTab, activeTonnageTab, searchFilter)
          local filtered = {}
          local searchLower = string.lower(searchFilter or "")

          for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              local matchesClassTab = (not activeTab) or (card.tonnage == activeTab)
              local matchesTonnageTab = (not activeTonnageTab) or (card.shipTonnage == activeTonnageTab)
              local matchesSearch = (searchFilter == "") or string.find(string.lower(card.name or ""), searchLower, 1, true)

              if matchesClassTab and matchesTonnageTab and matchesSearch then
                  local cardCopy = duplicateTable(card)
                  cardCopy.originalIndex = i
                  table.insert(filtered, cardCopy)
              end
          end

      return filtered
  end

  function countCardsInCategory(categoryName)
          local count = 0
          for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              if card.tonnage == categoryName then
                  count = count + 1
              end
          end
      return count
  end

  function countCardsInTonnage(tonnageName)
          local count = 0
          for _, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
              if card.shipTonnage == tonnageName then

              end
          end
      return count
  end

  function escapeXml(str)
          if not str then return "" end
          str = str:gsub("&", "&")
          str = str:gsub("<", "<")
          str = str:gsub(">", ">")
          str = str:gsub('"', """)
          str = str:gsub("'", "'")
      return str
  end
