  -- Simple JSON array parser for the fleet format:
  -- [ {"name": "Ship Name", "number": 2}, ... ]
  -- Also supports top-level object: {"ships": [...]} or {"fleet": [...]}
  -- Detect if this JSON text is a BattleScribe/NewRecruit roster format.
  -- Rosters contain "roster" at the top level and use "type":"model" for ship entries.
  function isBattleScribeRoster(jsonText)
      -- Quick heuristic: contains the roster wrapper key and model type markers
      return jsonText:find('"roster"', 1, true) ~= nil
          and jsonText:find('"type":"model"', 1, true) ~= nil
  end

  -- Find the matching closing brace/bracket for an opening one.
  -- Returns the index of the closing char, or nil if not found.
  function findMatchingClose(text, openPos)
      local openChar = text:sub(openPos, openPos)
      local closeChar = (openChar == "{") and "}" or "]"
      local depth = 0
      local inString = false
      local escape = false
      for i = openPos, #text do
          local c = text:sub(i, i)
          if escape then
              escape = false
          elseif c == "\\" and inString then
              escape = true
          elseif c == '"' then
              inString = not inString
          elseif not inString then
              if c == openChar then depth = depth + 1
              elseif c == closeChar then
                  depth = depth - 1
                  if depth == 0 then return i end
              end
          end
      end
      return nil
  end

  -- Extract the string value for a given key from a JSON object string.
  -- Only looks at the immediate level (not nested), handles escaped quotes.
function extractJsonString(objStr, key)
    if not objStr or not key then return nil end

    -- Find the opening quote of the VALUE, not just the start of the key.
    local _, valQuoteEnd = objStr:find('"' .. key .. '"%s*:%s*"')
    if not valQuoteEnd then return nil end

    local val = {}
    local i = valQuoteEnd + 1

    while i <= #objStr do
        local c = objStr:sub(i, i)

        if c == "\\" then
            i = i + 1
            if i <= #objStr then
                local escaped = objStr:sub(i, i)

                if escaped == "n" then
                    table.insert(val, "\n")
                elseif escaped == "t" then
                    table.insert(val, "\t")
                elseif escaped == "r" then
                    table.insert(val, "\r")
                else
                    table.insert(val, escaped)
                end
            end
        elseif c == '"' then
            break
        else
            table.insert(val, c)
        end

        i = i + 1
    end

    return table.concat(val)
end

  -- Extract an integer value for a given key from a JSON object string.
  function extractJsonInt(objStr, key)
      local pattern = '"' .. key .. '"%s*:%s*(%d+)'
      local val = objStr:match(pattern)
      return val and tonumber(val) or nil
  end

  -- Parse a BattleScribe/NewRecruit roster JSON and return {name, quantity} list.
  -- Strategy: flat scan the entire JSON for every object that has "type":"model".
  -- Find each such object by scanning forward from every '"type":"model"' hit,
  -- then walk backward to find the opening '{' of that object.
  -- This completely avoids offset arithmetic across substrings.
  function parseBattleScribeRoster(jsonText)
      local results = {}
      local searchStr = '"type":"model"'
      local pos = 1
      local L = #jsonText

      while pos <= L do
          -- Find next occurrence of "type":"model"
          local hitPos = jsonText:find(searchStr, pos, true)
          if not hitPos then break end

          -- Walk backward from hitPos to find the '{' that opened this object.
          -- We need to find the '{' at depth 0 relative to hitPos.
          local objStart = nil
          local depth = 0
          for i = hitPos, 1, -1 do
              local c = jsonText:sub(i, i)
              if c == "}" then
                  depth = depth + 1
              elseif c == "{" then
                  if depth == 0 then
                      objStart = i
                      break
                  else
                      depth = depth - 1
                  end
              end
          end

          if objStart then
              local objEnd = findMatchingClose(jsonText, objStart)
              if objEnd then
                  local objStr = jsonText:sub(objStart, objEnd)
                  -- Double-check this object really has type=model at top level
                  -- (not buried in a nested child). We verify by checking that
                  -- "type":"model" appears before the first nested '{' after objStart.
                  local firstNested = objStr:find("{", 2, true) or (#objStr + 1)
                  local typePos = objStr:find('"type":"model"', 1, true) or (#objStr + 1)
                  -- Also accept if type appears anywhere in this object's flat keys
                  -- (BattleScribe puts type near the top, before selections)
                  local name   = extractJsonString(objStr, "name")
                  local number = extractJsonInt(objStr, "number") or 1
                  if name and trimString(name) ~= "" then
                      if number < 1  then number = 1  end
                      if number > 20 then number = 20 end
                      table.insert(results, {name = trimString(name), quantity = number})
                  end
                  pos = objEnd + 1
              else
                  pos = hitPos + #searchStr
              end
          else
              pos = hitPos + #searchStr
          end
      end

      return results
  end

  -- Parse a simple fleet JSON: [{name="...", number=N}, ...]
  -- Also handles wrapper objects like {"ships": [...]}
  function parseSimpleFleetJSON(jsonText)
      local entries = {}

      -- Unwrap object wrapper if present
      if jsonText:sub(1,1) == "{" then
          local arrStart = jsonText:find("%[")
          local arrEnd   = jsonText:find("%][^%[%]]*$")
          if arrStart and arrEnd then
              jsonText = jsonText:sub(arrStart, arrEnd)
          else
              return entries
          end
      end

  function splitIntoLines(text)
          local lines = {}
          local currentLine = ""
          for i = 1, #text do
              local char = text:sub(i, i)
              if char == "\n" or char == "\r" then
                  if #currentLine > 0 then
                      table.insert(lines, currentLine)
                      currentLine = ""
                  end
              else
                  currentLine = currentLine .. char
              end
          end
          if #currentLine > 0 then
              table.insert(lines, currentLine)
          end
      return lines
  end

  function removeLineNumber(line)
          local dotPos = findChar(line, ".")
          if dotPos and dotPos < 5 then
              local beforeDot = trimString(line:sub(1, dotPos - 1))
              if isNumeric(beforeDot) then
                  return trimString(line:sub(dotPos + 1))
              end
          end
      return line
  end

 function extractShipEntries(lines)
    local entries = {}

    -- Modes:
    -- "ignore"  : Admirals, Launch Assets — skip
    -- "famous"  : Famous Admirals — only bullet lines that contain a real ship entry
    -- "heavy"   : Colossal/Heavy Groups, Space Stations — treat lines as ships, but still skip headings if next is bullet
    -- "grouped" : Medium/Light/Payload Groups — bullets are ships, headings skipped, non-bullet single-ship lines allowed
    local mode = "ignore"

    for lineIdx, rawLine in ipairs(lines) do
        local line = trimString(rawLine or "")
        if #line > 0 then
            local lowerLine = line:lower()

            -- Section switches (order matters)
            if contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
                mode = "famous"

            elseif contains(lowerLine, "colossal groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "heavy groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "space stations") then
                mode = "heavy"

            elseif contains(lowerLine, "medium groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "light groups")
                or contains(lowerLine, "payload groups") then
                mode = "grouped"

            elseif contains(lowerLine, "admirals")
                or contains(lowerLine, "launch assets") then
                mode = "ignore"

            else
                -- Skip obvious markdown headers and header-like noise lines
                if line:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" and not isHeaderLine(line) then
                    local isBullet = startsWithBullet(line)

                    if mode == "famous" then
                        -- Only accept bullet lines that actually parse into ship entries
                        if isBullet then
                            local extracted = extractInlineShipEntries(line)
                            if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                                for _, e in ipairs(extracted) do
                                    table.insert(entries, e)
                                end
                            end
                        end

                    elseif mode == "grouped" then
                        local nextIsBullet = nextNonEmptyIsBullet(lines, lineIdx)

                        -- If the next non-empty line is a bullet list and this looks like a heading, skip it
                        if not shouldSkipAsHeading(line, nextIsBullet) then
                            -- If it isn't a bullet and the next isn't a bullet, treat as single-ship line
                            local isSingleShipEntry = (not isBullet) and (not nextIsBullet)

                            if isBullet or isSingleShipEntry then
                                local extracted = extractInlineShipEntries(line)
                                if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                                    for _, e in ipairs(extracted) do
                                        table.insert(entries, e)
                                    end
                                else
                                    local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                                    if entry then table.insert(entries, entry) end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                    elseif mode == "heavy" then
                        local nextIsBullet = nextNonEmptyIsBullet(lines, lineIdx)

                        -- Same heading-skip rule here, prevents duplicates if heavy sections use headings+bullets
                        if not shouldSkipAsHeading(line, nextIsBullet) then
                            local extracted = extractInlineShipEntries(line)
                            if extracted and #extracted > 0 then
                                for _, e in ipairs(extracted) do
                                    table.insert(entries, e)
                                end
                            else
                                local entry = parseShipLine(line)
                                if entry then table.insert(entries, entry) end
                            end
                        end

                    else
                        -- mode == "ignore": do nothing
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return entries
end



  function isHeaderLine(line)
          if #line == 0 then return true end
          if line:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return true end

      local lowerLine = line:lower()

      if contains(lowerLine, "configuration") or
         contains(lowerLine, "game size") or
         contains(lowerLine, "fleet ++") or
         contains(lowerLine, "famous admirals") then
          return true
      end

      if (contains(lowerLine, "admirals") or contains(lowerLine, "groups")) and
         contains(lowerLine, "[") and contains(lowerLine, "pts]") then
          if not contains(lowerLine, "•") and not contains(line, "x ") then
              return true
          end
      end

      return false
  end

  function parseShipLine(line)
      line = trimString(line)
      if #line == 0 then return nil end

      line = removeLineNumber(line)
      line = trimString(line)

      local colonPos = findChar(line, ":")
      local bulletPresent = startsWithBullet(line)

      if colonPos == #line and not bulletPresent then
          local hasQuantity = false
          for i = 1, 6 do
              if i < #line and line:sub(i, i) == "x" and line:sub(i+1, i+1) == " " then
                  hasQuantity = true
                  break
              end
          end
          if not hasQuantity then
              return nil
          end
      end

      if bulletPresent then
          line = stripBulletPrefix(line)
      end

      local quantity = 1
      local xPos = findChar(line, "x")
      if xPos and xPos < 6 then
          local beforeX = trimString(line:sub(1, xPos - 1))
          if isNumeric(beforeX) then
              quantity = tonumber(beforeX) or 1
              line = trimString(line:sub(xPos + 2))
          end
      end

      local bracketPos = findChar(line, "[")
      colonPos = findChar(line, ":")

      local nameEnd = #line
      if bracketPos and (not colonPos or bracketPos < colonPos) then
          nameEnd = bracketPos - 1
      elseif colonPos then
          nameEnd = colonPos - 1
      end

      local shipName = trimString(line:sub(1, nameEnd))

      if #shipName < 3 then return nil end

      local lowerName = shipName:lower()

      if contains(lowerName, "lvl ") or contains(lowerName, "captain") or contains(lowerName, "admiral") then
          return nil
      end

      if contains(shipName, " - ") and (shipName:sub(-2) == " -" or contains(shipName, "pts]")) then
          return nil
      end

      return {name = shipName, quantity = quantity}
  end

  function findMatchingCards(searchName)
      local matches = {}
      local searchLower = trimString((searchName or ""):lower())
      if searchLower == "" then return matches end

      local searchTokens = tokenizeWords(searchLower)

      local bestScore = -1
      local bestIndex = nil

      for i, card in ipairs(savedShipCards) do
          local cardName = trimString(card.name or "")
          local cardLower = cardName:lower()
          if cardLower ~= "" then
              local score = -1

              if cardLower == searchLower then
                  -- Exact string match is always best
                  score = 100000 + #cardLower
              else
                  local cardTokens = tokenizeWords(cardLower)

                  -- Only allow "token subset" matches where the SEARCH is >= the CARD in specificity.
                  -- This prevents "Cruiser" from matching "Light Cruiser", "Heavy Cruiser", etc.
                  if tokensContainAll(searchTokens, cardTokens) then
                      -- Prefer longer (more specific) card names within this tier
                      score = 50000 + (#cardTokens * 100) + #cardLower
                  end

                  -- Fallback fuzzy contains (lowest priority)
                  if score < 0 then
                      if contains(searchLower, cardLower) or contains(cardLower, searchLower) then
                          score = 1000 + math.min(#cardLower, #searchLower)
                      end
                  end
              end

              if score > bestScore then
                  bestScore = score
                  bestIndex = i
              end
          end
      end

      if bestIndex then
          table.insert(matches, bestIndex)
      end

      return matches
  end
  function trimString(str)
      if not str then return "" end
      local startPos = 1
      while startPos <= #str do
          local char = str:sub(startPos, startPos)
          if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
              break
          end
          startPos = startPos + 1
      end
      local endPos = #str
      while endPos >= 1 do
          local char = str:sub(endPos, endPos)
          if char ~= " " and char ~= "\t" and char ~= "\r" and char ~= "\n" then
              break
          end
          endPos = endPos - 1
      end
      if startPos > endPos then return "" end
      return str:sub(startPos, endPos)
  end

  function findChar(str, char)
      for i = 1, #str do
          if str:sub(i, i) == char then
              return i
          end
      end
      return nil
  end

  function contains(str, substr)
      if not str or not substr then return false end
      if #substr > #str then return false end
      for i = 1, #str - #substr + 1 do
          local match = true
          for j = 1, #substr do
              if str:sub(i + j - 1, i + j - 1) ~= substr:sub(j, j) then
                  match = false
                  break
              end
          end
          if match then return true end
      end
      return false
  end

  function isNumeric(str)
      if not str or #str == 0 then return false end
      for i = 1, #str do
          local char = str:sub(i, i)
          if char < "0" or char > "9" then
              return false
          end
      end
      return true
  end

--- Reconstruct the full ship JSON from template + per-ship data.
--- Uses TTS's built-in JSON module to safely inject the LuaScript.
function buildFullShipJSON(card)
    if not card or not card.shipVars or not card.shipObjJson then return nil end
    if not shipScriptTemplate or shipScriptTemplate == "" then return nil end

    local fullScript = buildScriptHeader(card.shipVars) .. shipScriptTemplate
    local shipObj = JSON.decode(card.shipObjJson)
    if not shipObj then
        broadcastToAll("ERROR: Failed to decode ship JSON for " .. (card.name or "?"), {1, 0, 0})
        return nil
    end

    shipObj.LuaScript      = fullScript
    shipObj.LuaScriptState = card.shipState or ""

    return JSON.encode(shipObj)
end

--- Find a safe Lua long-string delimiter level for the given text.
--- Returns the equals string (e.g. "======" for [======[...]======]).
function findSafeDelimiter(text)
    local level = 6
    while true do
        local closeDelim = "]" .. string.rep("=", level) .. "]"
        if not text:find(closeDelim, 1, true) then
            return string.rep("=", level)
        end
        level = level + 1
    end
end

--- Build the full spawner-tile JSON string from a card entry.
--- Reconstructs the ship -> wraps it in a spawner tile -> returns spawn-ready JSON.
function buildSpawnerTileJSON(card)
    -- 1. Reconstruct the full ship JSON string
    local shipJson = buildFullShipJSON(card)
    if not shipJson then return nil end

    -- 2. Build the spawner-tile Lua: script template + objectJSON assignment
    local eq = findSafeDelimiter(shipJson)
    local spawnerLua = spawnerScriptTemplate
        .. "\nobjectJSON = [" .. eq .. "[" .. shipJson .. "]" .. eq .. "]"

    -- 3. Clone the spawner tile JSON template and fill in per-ship values
    local tile = JSON.decode(spawnerTileTemplate)
    if not tile then
        broadcastToAll("ERROR: Failed to decode spawner tile template", {1, 0, 0})
        return nil
    end

    tile.Nickname    = card.name or "Unknown"
    tile.Description = card.description or ""
    tile.LuaScript   = spawnerLua

    if tile.CustomImage then
        tile.CustomImage.ImageURL          = card.imageURL or ""
        tile.CustomImage.ImageSecondaryURL = card.imageURL or ""
    end

    return JSON.encode(tile)
end

function spawnCardsForPlayer(playerColor, cardIndices)
    if not playerSpawnCounts then playerSpawnCounts = {} end

    local spawnConfig = CONFIG.PLAYER_SPAWN_POSITIONS[playerColor]
    if not spawnConfig then
        spawnConfig = {
            position  = {x = 0, y = 1, z = 0},
            rotation  = {x = 0, y = 0, z = 0},
            direction = {x = 1, y = 0, z = 0},
        }
        broadcastToColor(
            "Warning: No spawn position configured for " .. playerColor .. ", using center.",
            playerColor, {1, 1, 0}
        )
    end

    local startPos     = spawnConfig.position
    local rotation     = spawnConfig.rotation
    local direction    = spawnConfig.direction
    local spacing      = CONFIG.CARD_SPAWN_SPACING
    local cardsPerRow  = CONFIG.CARDS_PER_ROW or 6

    local rowDirection = {
        x = direction.z,
        y = 0,
        z = direction.x,
    }

    local currentCount = playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] or 0

    for i, cardIndex in ipairs(cardIndices) do
        local card = savedShipCards[cardIndex]
        if card then
            local spawnJson = nil

            -- New template format: reconstruct spawner tile on-the-fly
            if card.shipObjJson and card.shipVars then
                spawnJson = buildSpawnerTileJSON(card)
            -- Legacy format: pre-built spawner tile JSON
            elseif card.json then
                spawnJson = card.json
            end

            if spawnJson then
                local col = currentCount % cardsPerRow
                local row = math.floor(currentCount / cardsPerRow)
                local colOffset = col * spacing
                local rowOffset = row * spacing
                local spawnPos = {
                    x = startPos.x + (direction.x * colOffset) + (rowDirection.x * rowOffset),
                    y = startPos.y,
                    z = startPos.z + (direction.z * colOffset) + (rowDirection.z * rowOffset),
                }

                spawnObjectJSON({
                    json     = spawnJson,
                    position = spawnPos,
                    rotation = rotation,
                    sound    = true,
                })

                currentCount = currentCount + 1
            end
        end
    end

    playerSpawnCounts[playerColor] = currentCount
end

function generateCourseChangeGuideLines()
    cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = {}

    if not pivotPosition or not startForwardVec then return end

    local MIN_RANGE, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC, MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC = getMovementParameters()
    local guideLen = 5 * UNIT_SCALE

    local leftLimitVec  = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
    local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y',  MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)

    local leftEnd  = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec  * guideLen)
    local rightEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * guideLen)

    -- Convert to local space so setVectorLines works correctly
    local localOrigin = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
    localOrigin.y = localOrigin.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

    local localLeft  = self.positionToLocal(leftEnd)
    localLeft.y  = localLeft.y  + LINE_Y_OFFSET
    local localRight = self.positionToLocal(rightEnd)
    localRight.y = localRight.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

    table.insert(cachedCourseChangeGuideLines, {
        points    = { localOrigin, localLeft },
        color     = {1, 1, 1},
        thickness = 0.08,
        rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
    })
    table.insert(cachedCourseChangeGuideLines, {
        points    = { localOrigin, localRight },
        color     = {1, 1, 1},
        thickness = 0.08,
        rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
    })
end

function generateFiringArcLines()
    cachedFiringArcLines = {}

    local forward = Vector(0,0,1)
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then forward = Vector(1,0,0) end

    -- Calculate scan radius to match scan lines
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * (10/3) * UNIT_SCALE

    -- Set arc line length to 16" (extends 16" on each side = 32" total)
        local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
        local arcLineLength = 16 * UNIT_SCALE / scale

    -- Helper to add symmetric lines with custom color
    local function addAngleLines(angleDeg, lineColor)
        local rotRight = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', angleDeg)
        local rotLeft = forward:copy():rotateOver('y', -angleDeg)

        -- Line 1 (Right side) - extends from -arcLineLength to +arcLineLength
        local p1 = rotRight * arcLineLength
        local p2 = rotRight * (-arcLineLength)
        p1.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p2.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p1, p2 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })

        -- Line 2 (Left side)
        local p3 = rotLeft * arcLineLength
        local p4 = rotLeft * (-arcLineLength)
        p3.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET
        p4.y = LINE_Y_OFFSET

        table.insert(cachedFiringArcLines, {
            points = { p3, p4 },
            color = lineColor,
            thickness = 0.1
        })
    end

    -- Front/Side/Rear (45 degrees) - Dark Red
    addAngleLines(45, {0, 0, 0.6})

    -- Front/Rear Narrow (11 degrees) - Dark Blue
    addAngleLines(11, {0.6, 0, 0})
end

function generateScanLines()
    cachedScanLines = {}
    local circleColor = {0.5, 1, 0.5}    -- Light Green

    -- Circle Scan Range - use ShipScan variable
    local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local scanRadius = ShipScan * UNIT_SCALE / scale

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * scanRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * scanRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedScanLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.1
    })
end

function onPickUp(player_color)
      -- Reset move tracker when starting a new radial move
      accumulatedDistance = 0
      UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()

      -- Check if MoveOff is active - if so, skip radial movement setup
      -- If Free Move is active (or deploying), radial movement and vectored logic are disabled
      if IsFreeMove() then
          isHeld = false

          -- Hard reset any in-progress vectored / course-change sequencing
          vectoredPhase = 1
          vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
          vectoredReminderActive = false

          -- Optional but recommended, avoids “half-complete” states lingering
          courseChangePhase = 1
          courseChangeDistance = 0

          return
      end


    isHeld = true
    holdingPlayerColor = player_color

    -- Store pickup position/rotation for undo (do this FIRST)
    pickupPosition = self.getPosition()
    pickupRotation = self.getRotation()

    -- Record the position and rotation where the object was picked up
    pivotPosition = self.getPosition()  -- Always use current position as pivot
    startRotation = self.getRotation()
    currentSmoothedPos = self.getPosition()

    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"

    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        -- Do NOT auto-advance phases on pickup.
        -- Phases are advanced onDrop (especially important for vectored ships).
        if courseChangePhase == nil then courseChangePhase = 1 end
        if courseChangeDistance == nil then courseChangeDistance = 0 end
    else
        -- Reset Course Change tracking when leaving the order
        courseChangePhase = 1
        courseChangeDistance = 0
    end


    -- VECTORED: two-leg movement for ANY order (except CourseChange, which already has its own 2-phase logic)
    if Vectored and activeOrder ~= "CourseChange" then
        -- If we completed leg 1 previously, next pickup becomes leg 2
        if vectoredPhase == 1 and vectoredLeg1Distance > 0 then
            vectoredPhase = 2
            print("[FFAA00]Vectored: Phase 2 - extra 45° bend then remaining move [-]")
        elseif vectoredPhase ~= 2 then
            -- Starting fresh
            vectoredPhase = 1
            vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
        end
    else
        -- Not vectored (or CourseChange), always reset vectored state
        vectoredPhase = 1
        vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
    end


    -- Determine the starting "Forward" vector based on the model configuration
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformRight() -- Local X-axis
    else
        startForwardVec = self.getTransformForward() -- Local Z-axis
    end
    -- Flatten Y to ensure 2D calculations
    startForwardVec.y = 0
    startForwardVec:normalize()
end

function onDrop(player_color)
    -- TRACKING: Add current segment to accumulated distance
    if isHeld and pickupPosition then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local dist = Vector.distance(pickupPosition, currentPos) / UNIT_SCALE
        accumulatedDistance = accumulatedDistance + dist
        -- Update UI immediately
        UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()
    end

    isHeld = false
    holdingPlayerColor = nil

    -- Clear physics velocities to prevent "fling" effect on release
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0, 0, 0))

    local freeMove = IsFreeMove()
    if freeMove then
        -- If they free-moved the ship, never progress vectored/course change sequencing
        vectoredPhase = 1
        vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
        vectoredReminderActive = false

        -- Keep aura visuals correct
        updateAuraVisuals()
        return
    end

    -- COURSE CHANGE: phase progression handled onDrop
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local diffX = currentPos.x - pivotPosition.x
        local diffZ = currentPos.z - pivotPosition.z
        local movedDistance = math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffZ * diffZ) / UNIT_SCALE

        if not Vectored then
                    -- Normal Course Change: Phase 1 (move) -> Phase 2 (rotate only) -> reset
                    if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                        if movedDistance > 0.1 then
                            courseChangeDistance = movedDistance
                            courseChangePhase = 2
                            courseChangeReminderActive = true
                            generateCourseChangeGuideLines()
                            broadcastToAll("[22AA22]Course Change: Phase 1 complete - Moved " ..
                                string.format("%.1f", courseChangeDistance) ..
                                " inches. Pick up again to rotate (NO MOVEMENT) [-]")
                        else
                            courseChangePhase = 1
                            courseChangeDistance = 0
                            courseChangeReminderActive = false
                            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                        end
                    else
                        -- Finished rotate-only stage
                        courseChangePhase = 1
                        courseChangeDistance = 0
                        courseChangeReminderActive = false
                        cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                    end

        else
            -- VECTORED + Course Change: Phase 1 (leg1 move) -> Phase 2 (leg2 move) -> Phase 3 (rotate only) -> reset
            if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                            -- Record leg 1 distance (allow 0 for "bend early" play)
                            courseChangeDistance = math.max(0, movedDistance)
                            courseChangePhase = 2
                            courseChangeReminderActive = false  -- Not yet at rotate phase
                            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                            print("[22AA22]Course Change (Vectored): Leg 1 complete - " ..
                                string.format("%.1f", courseChangeDistance) ..
                                "\" moved. Pick up again for Vectored leg 2 [-]")

                        elseif courseChangePhase == 2 then
                            -- Completed leg 2, now go to rotate-only
                            courseChangePhase = 3
                            courseChangeReminderActive = true
                            generateCourseChangeGuideLines()
                            print("[FFAA00]Course Change (Vectored): Leg 2 complete. Pick up again to rotate (NO MOVEMENT) [-]")

                        else
                            -- Completed rotate-only
                            courseChangePhase = 1
                            courseChangeDistance = 0
                            courseChangeReminderActive = false
                            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
                        end
        end
    end

    -- VECTORED: after phase 1 drop, lock in leg 1 distance and require a second pickup for the remainder.
    -- After phase 2 drop, reset back to phase 1 for next movement.
    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    if Vectored and activeOrder ~= "CourseChange" then
        if vectoredPhase == 1 then
            -- Record how far we moved on leg 1 (in inches)
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local diffX = currentPos.x - pivotPosition.x
            local diffZ = currentPos.z - pivotPosition.z
            local movedDistance = math.sqrt(diffX * diffX + diffZ * diffZ) / UNIT_SCALE

            -- Store even if it is 0 (turn-at-start use case)
            vectoredLeg1Distance = math.max(0, movedDistance)
            vectoredPhase = 2

            print("[22AA22]Vectored: Phase 1 complete - " ..
                string.format("%.1f", vectoredLeg1Distance) ..
                "\" moved. Pick up again for extra bend + remaining move [-]")
            broadcastToAll("First part of vectored move complete, Move again to complete move", {1, 0.67, 0})
            vectoredReminderActive = true
            Sync()

        elseif vectoredPhase == 2 then
            vectoredPhase = 1
            vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
            vectoredReminderActive = false
            Sync()
        end
    end

    -- ORBIT RECOVERY: restore original thrust after one move post-atmosphere exit
    if orbitRecoveryPending then
        orbitRecoveryPending = false
        local shipName = self.getName() or "Unknown Ship"
        local restoredThrust = preAtmosphereThrust or ShipThrust
        ShipThrust = restoredThrust
        preAtmosphereThrust = nil
        print("[22AA22]" .. shipName .. " has successfully reached orbit, it's thrust is now " .. ShipThrust .. "\"[-]")
        Sync()
    end

    -- Update visuals based on Aura state
    updateAuraVisuals()
end

function updateRadialMovement(player)
    local pointerPos = player.getPointerPosition()

    -- Get movement parameters based on active special order
    local MIN_RANGE, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC, MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC = getMovementParameters()

    -- 1. Calculate Direction and Distance
    local diffX = pointerPos.x - pivotPosition.x
    local diffZ = pointerPos.z - pivotPosition.z
    local directionVec = Vector(diffX, 0, diffZ)
    local currentDist = directionVec:magnitude()

    -- 2. Deadzone / Movement Threshold Check
    if currentDist < MOVEMENT_THRESHOLD * UNIT_SCALE then
        self.setPosition(pivotPosition)
        self.setRotation(startRotation)
        self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
        self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

        currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition

        updateAuraVisuals()
        return
    end

    -- 3. Calculate Direction & Clamp Angle
    local moveDir = directionVec:normalized()

    -- Calculate angle difference between Start Forward and Current Direction
    local angleDiff = Vector.angle(startForwardVec, moveDir)

    -- Check if angle exceeds limit (use dynamic max turn angle)
    if angleDiff > MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC then
        local cross = startForwardVec:cross(moveDir)
        local sign = 1
        if cross.y < 0 then sign = -1 end
        moveDir = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', sign * MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
    end

    -- 4. Calculate New Position with MIN and MAX range
    local targetPos  -- Declare here so it's available throughout the function

      -- Special handling for Course Change order
      local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"

      -- Decide if this phase is "rotate-only"
      local rotateOnly = false
      if activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
          if Vectored then
              -- Vectored Course Change: Phase 3 is rotate-only
              rotateOnly = (courseChangePhase == 3)
          else
              -- Normal Course Change: Phase 2 is rotate-only
              rotateOnly = (courseChangePhase == 2)
          end
      end

      if activeOrder == "CourseChange" and rotateOnly then
          -- Rotate-only stage: NO MOVEMENT
          targetPos = pivotPosition
      else
          -- Standard clamping (includes Course Change phase 1 and vectored phase 2)
          local currentDistInches = currentDist / UNIT_SCALE
          local clampDistInches = math.max(MIN_RANGE, math.min(currentDistInches, MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC))
          local clampDist = clampDistInches * UNIT_SCALE
          targetPos = pivotPosition + (moveDir * clampDist)
      end


    -- Preserve the object's current height
    local currentHandPos = self.getPosition()
    targetPos.y = currentHandPos.y

    -- Smooth interpolation
    if currentSmoothedPos == nil then currentSmoothedPos = pivotPosition end
    currentSmoothedPos = currentSmoothedPos:lerp(targetPos, Time.delta_time * SMOOTH_SPEED)
    currentSmoothedPos.y = targetPos.y
    self.setPosition(currentSmoothedPos)

    -- 5. Calculate Rotation
    local targetAngle = moveDir:heading("y")
    if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
        targetAngle = targetAngle - 90
    end
    self.setRotation(Vector(0, targetAngle, 0))

    -- 6. Physics Cleanup
    self.setVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))
    self.setAngularVelocity(Vector(0,0,0))

    -- 7. Visual Feedback
    local finalLines = {}

    -- Add Aura visuals if enabled (firing arcs + scan)
    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
                    for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
                end
            end

            if (state.conditions.Launch or 0) > 0 and cachedLaunchLines then
                for _, l in ipairs(cachedLaunchLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
            end

        if DRAW_RAIL_LINE then
        local visualDir = moveDir
        local shipOffset = currentSmoothedPos - pivotPosition
        shipOffset.y = 0

        if shipOffset:magnitude() > 0.1 then
             visualDir = shipOffset:normalized()
        end

        -- Use dynamic max range for visual
        local railEnd = pivotPosition + (visualDir * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        local localStart = self.positionToLocal(pivotPosition)
        localStart.y = localStart.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localEnd = self.positionToLocal(railEnd)
        localEnd.y = localEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Use dynamic max turn angle for limit lines
        local leftLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', -MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)
        local rightLimitVec = startForwardVec:copy():rotateOver('y', MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC)

        local leftLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)
        local rightLimitEnd = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * MAX_RANGE_DYNAMIC * UNIT_SCALE)

        -- COURSE CHANGE PHASE 2 ROTATION GUIDES
        -- Draw short 5" guide lines so players can visualise the allowed rotation when range is 0
        if activeOrder == "CourseChange" and ((not Vectored and courseChangePhase == 2) or (Vectored and courseChangePhase == 3)) then
            local guideLen = 5 * UNIT_SCALE

            local leftGuideEndWorld  = pivotPosition + (leftLimitVec  * guideLen)
            local rightGuideEndWorld = pivotPosition + (rightLimitVec * guideLen)

            local localLeftGuideEnd  = self.positionToLocal(leftGuideEndWorld)
            localLeftGuideEnd.y = localLeftGuideEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

            local localRightGuideEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightGuideEndWorld)
            localRightGuideEnd.y = localRightGuideEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localLeftGuideEnd },
                color = {1, 1, 1},
                thickness = 0.08,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localRightGuideEnd },
                color = {1, 1, 1},
                thickness = 0.08,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end


        local localLeftEnd = self.positionToLocal(leftLimitEnd)
        localLeftEnd.y = localLeftEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET
        local localRightEnd = self.positionToLocal(rightLimitEnd)
        localRightEnd.y = localRightEnd.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET

        -- Main range line (white)
        table.insert(finalLines, {
            points = { localStart, localEnd },
            color = {1, 1, 1},
            thickness = 0.1,
            rotation = {0,0,0}
        })

        -- Only draw turn limit lines if turning is allowed
        if MAX_TURN_ANGLE_DYNAMIC > 0 then
            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localLeftEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = { localStart, localRightEnd },
                color = {1, 0, 0},
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end

        -- Draw minimum range circle if MIN_RANGE > 0
        if MIN_RANGE > 0 then
            local minCirclePoints = {}
            local segments = 32
            local step = 360 / segments
            for i = 0, segments do
                local angle = math.rad(i * step)
                local x = math.cos(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local z = math.sin(angle) * MIN_RANGE * UNIT_SCALE
                local worldPos = pivotPosition + Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z)
                table.insert(minCirclePoints, self.positionToLocal(worldPos))
            end

            table.insert(finalLines, {
                points = minCirclePoints,
                color = {1, 1, 0},  -- Yellow for minimum range
                thickness = 0.05,
                rotation = {0,0,0}
            })
        end
    end

    self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function generateSignatureLines()
    cachedSignatureLines = {}

    if not state.sigAuraShown or state.sig == 0 then
        return  -- Don't generate if not shown or sig is 0
    end

    local circleColor = {0.8, 0, 0}  -- Red for signature

    -- Calculate signature radius
    local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local sigRadius = state.sig * UNIT_SCALE / scale

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * sigRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * sigRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedSignatureLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15  -- Slightly thicker than scan lines
    })
end

function generateLaunchLines()
    cachedLaunchLines = {}

    local circleColor = {1, 0.6, 0}  -- Orange for launch range

    local scale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local launchRadius = 6 * UNIT_SCALE / scale  -- 6 inches

    local circlePoints = {}
    local segments = 64
    local step = 360 / segments
    for i = 0, segments do
        local angle = math.rad(i * step)
        local x = math.cos(angle) * launchRadius
        local z = math.sin(angle) * launchRadius
        table.insert(circlePoints, Vector(x, LINE_Y_OFFSET, z))
    end

    table.insert(cachedLaunchLines, {
        points = circlePoints,
        color = circleColor,
        thickness = 0.15
    })
end

function getMovementParameters()
    if not ShipThrust or ShipThrust == 0 then
        ShipThrust = 9
    end

    -- NAVIGATION OFFLINE: hard cap 2", no turning
    if (state.conditions.Navigation_Offline or 0) > 0 then
        return 0, 2, 0
    end

    local activeOrder = state.activeSpecialOrder or "GeneralQuarters"
    local halfThrust = ShipThrust / 2
    local fullThrust = ShipThrust
    local doubleThrust = ShipThrust * 2

    -- Base parameters for the current order
    local baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn

    if activeOrder == "GeneralQuarters" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 45

    elseif activeOrder == "SilentRunningOrder" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "WeaponsFree" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 0

      elseif activeOrder == "CourseChange" then
          -- COURSE CHANGE:
          -- Normal ship: Phase 1 = move up to half thrust, Phase 2 = rotate only
          -- Vectored ship: Phase 1 = move leg 1, Phase 2 = move leg 2 (vectored bend), Phase 3 = rotate only

          if Vectored then
              if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                  -- Leg 1: up to half thrust
                  return 0, halfThrust, 45
              elseif courseChangePhase == 2 then
                  -- Leg 2: remaining distance up to half thrust, allow bend (45)
                  local leg1 = courseChangeDistance or 0
                  local remainingMax = math.max(0, halfThrust - leg1)
                  return 0, remainingMax, 45
              else
                  -- Phase 3: rotate only, no movement
                  return 0, 0, 45
              end
          else
              -- Normal non-vectored Course Change behaviour (your original)
              if courseChangePhase == 1 then
                  return 0, halfThrust, 45
              else
                  return 0, 0, 45
              end
          end


    elseif activeOrder == "MaxThrust" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = fullThrust, doubleThrust, 0

    elseif activeOrder == "DamageControl" then
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = 0, halfThrust, 45

    else
        baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn = halfThrust, fullThrust, 45
    end

    -- VECTORED override (applies to any order except CourseChange)
    if Vectored and activeOrder ~= "CourseChange" then
        if vectoredPhase == 1 then
            -- Leg 1: MIN disabled, so you can do 0 move then bend at start
            return 0, baseMax, baseTurn

        elseif vectoredPhase == 2 then
            -- Leg 2: remaining distance, and MIN enforced by total (leg1 + leg2)
            local remainingMax = math.max(0, baseMax - (vectoredLeg1Distance or 0))
            local remainingMin = math.max(0, baseMin - (vectoredLeg1Distance or 0))

            -- Extra bend allowance: at least 45° for leg 2, even if baseTurn is 0
            local turn2 = math.max(baseTurn or 0, 45)

            return remainingMin, remainingMax, turn2
        end
    end

    -- Default: base order params
    return baseMin, baseMax, baseTurn
end


function updateAuraVisuals()
    local finalLines = {}

    local auraSize = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    if auraSize > 0 then
        if cachedFiringArcLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedFiringArcLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
        if cachedScanLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedScanLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end
    end

    if state.sigAuraShown and cachedSignatureLines then
                for _, l in ipairs(cachedSignatureLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
            end

        if (state.conditions.Launch or 0) > 0 and cachedLaunchLines then
            for _, l in ipairs(cachedLaunchLines) do table.insert(finalLines, l) end
        end

        -- Persistent course change rotation guides (always generated from current position)
            if courseChangeReminderActive then
                local guideLen = 5 * UNIT_SCALE

                -- Determine the ship's current forward vector
                local currentForward
                if MODEL_FACES_X_AXIS then
                    currentForward = self.getTransformRight()
                else
                    currentForward = self.getTransformForward()
                end
                currentForward.y = 0
                currentForward:normalize()

                local leftLimitVec  = currentForward:copy():rotateOver('y', -45)
                local rightLimitVec = currentForward:copy():rotateOver('y',  45)

                local shipPos = self.getPosition()
                local origin  = Vector(shipPos.x, shipPos.y + LINE_Y_OFFSET, shipPos.z)

                local leftEnd  = origin + (leftLimitVec  * guideLen)
                local rightEnd = origin + (rightLimitVec * guideLen)

                local localOrigin = self.positionToLocal(origin)
                local localLeft   = self.positionToLocal(leftEnd)
                local localRight  = self.positionToLocal(rightEnd)

                table.insert(finalLines, {
                    points    = { localOrigin, localLeft },
                    color     = {1, 1, 1},
                    thickness = 0.08,
                    rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
                })
                table.insert(finalLines, {
                    points    = { localOrigin, localRight },
                    color     = {1, 1, 1},
                    thickness = 0.08,
                    rotation  = {0, 0, 0}
                })
            end

        self.setVectorLines(finalLines)
end

function onLoad(save)

    local isNewShipType = (savedShipID ~= SHIP_ID)

    if isNewShipType then
        print("New ship type detected: " .. SHIP_ID .. " - Using script default stats")
    end

    if data.Vectored ~= nil then Vectored = data.Vectored end
    if data.Monitor  ~= nil then Monitor  = data.Monitor end

    -- Orbital data
    if data.preAtmosphereThrust ~= nil then preAtmosphereThrust = data.preAtmosphereThrust end
    if data.orbitRecoveryPending ~= nil then orbitRecoveryPending = data.orbitRecoveryPending end

    state.moveNumber = data.moveNumber or 5
    state.fractionNumber = data.fractionNumber or 0

    -- Load ALL ship stats - use defaults if new ship type, otherwise use saved
    if isNewShipType then
        -- Keep all the values defined at the top of the script
    else
        -- Load saved stats
        Shiphealth = data.Shiphealth or Shiphealth
        ShipbaseSize = data.ShipbaseSize or ShipbaseSize
        Shipcost = data.Shipcost or Shipcost
        ShipScan = data.ShipScan or ShipScan
        ShipThrust = data.ShipThrust or ShipThrust

        if data.admiralLevel then
            admiralLevel = data.admiralLevel
        end

        -- Load URLs if they were saved
        if data.SHIPCardURL then
            SHIPCardURL = data.SHIPCardURL
        end
        if data.FIXED_IMAGE_URL then
            FIXED_IMAGE_URL = data.FIXED_IMAGE_URL
        end

        -- Load player color if saved
        if data.playerColor then
            playerColor = data.playerColor
        end
    end

    -- ===== NEW: Scale model based on base size =====
    local targetScale = getScaleFromBaseSize(ShipbaseSize)
    local currentScale = self.getScale()

    -- Only rescale if it's different (avoids unnecessary scaling)
    if currentScale.x ~= targetScale then
        self.setScale({targetScale, targetScale, targetScale})
        print("Ship scaled to " .. targetScale .. " based on " .. ShipbaseSize .. "mm base")
    end

    -- Restore state
    recoverState(data)

    -- Reset health if new ship type
    if isNewShipType then
        state.health = { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = state.base or {}
        state.base.size = ShipbaseSize
    end

    -- Initialize pickup vars as nil
    pickupPosition = nil
    pickupRotation = nil

    -- Retrieve MenuManager
    MenuManager = getObjectFromGUID(MenuManagerGUID)

    -- Initialize SignatureStorage
    if isNewShipType then
        SignatureStorage = Signature
    else
        SignatureStorage = data.baseSignature or state.sig or Signature
    end

    -- Load deploy mode state
    if isNewShipType then
        deployMode = true
        state.conditions.MoveOff = 1
    elseif data.deployMode ~= nil then
        deployMode = data.deployMode
        if deployMode then
            state.conditions.MoveOff = 1
        end
    else
        deployMode = false  -- Default for legacy saves (already deployed)
    end

    -- Generate firing arc and scan lines
    generateFiringArcLines()
    generateScanLines()

    -- Rebuild UI and assets
    rebuildAssets()
    self.UI.setXml(ui())

    -- Additional setup
    RefreshModelShape()
    showMeasurementLine()

    -- Recalculate signature based on the loaded base value and current spikes
    RecalculateSignature()

    -- Update visuals based on loaded Aura state
    updateAuraVisuals()

    -- Restore 3D model state (add this after recoverState)
        if data.Model3DAvailable ~= nil then
            Model3DAvailable = data.Model3DAvailable
        end
        if data.savedModelScale then
            savedModelScale = data.savedModelScale
        end

        -- IMPORTANT: Clear the cached index so it searches fresh
        modelAttachmentIndex = nil

    self.addContextMenuItem("Toggle 3D Model", function()
            -- Check if a 3D model exists for this ship
            if not Model3DExists then
                local modelName = self.getName()
                print("[FF4444]═══════════════════════════════════════════[-]")
                print("[FFAA00]Sadly, no one has scanned a model for " .. modelName .. " yet.[-]")
                print("[FFAA00]If you can, please contact the DFC TTS team and let them know![-]")
                print("[FF4444]═══════════════════════════════════════════[-]")
                return  -- Don't allow toggle
            end

            -- If model exists, allow normal toggle
            Model3DAvailable = not Model3DAvailable
            print("=== TOGGLING 3D MODEL ===")
            print("New state: " .. tostring(Model3DAvailable))
            apply3DModelState()
        end)

        Wait.frames(function()
                RefreshShip()
            end, 10)

            Wait.frames(function()
                apply3DModelState()
            end, 20)

    end

    if ChildObjs.measurement_line ~= nil then ChildObjs.measurement_line.destruct() end

    -- Reset ProjectArcs condition safely
    if state and state.conditions and state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 then
        state.conditions.ProjectArcs = 0
    end
end

    data.fractionNumber = state.fractionNumber
    data.baseSignature = SignatureStorage
    data.admiralLevel = admiralLevel
    data.preAtmosphereThrust = preAtmosphereThrust

function onUpdate()
    if not state or not state.conditions then return end

    -- Handle radial movement when held (but not if MoveOff is active)
    if isHeld and pivotPosition and holdingPlayerColor and (not state.conditions.MoveOff or state.conditions.MoveOff == 0) then
        local player = Player[holdingPlayerColor]
        if player then
            updateRadialMovement(player)
        else
            onDrop(nil)
        end
    end

    -- Add safe checks for ProjectArcs condition
    if state.conditions.ProjectArcs and state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0 and
       ((ChildObjs.aura_obj) or (state.sigAuraShown and ChildObjs.sig_aura_obj)) then
        ProjectArcsForward()
    end

    -- UI is now fixed orientation (no per-frame rotation) for multiplayer performance

    -- Update measurement line only when ship rotation actually changes
    if ChildObjs.measurement_line then
        local rotation = self.getRotation()
        local rotY = math.floor(rotation.y * 10) / 10  -- Round to 0.1 degree
        if rotY ~= lastMeasurementRotY then
            lastMeasurementRotY = rotY
            ChildObjs.measurement_line.setRotation({0, rotation.y + 90, 0})
        end
    end

    UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()
end

function resetMovement(player, value, id)
    accumulatedDistance = 0
    UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()
end

function UPDATE_MOVEMENT_UI()
    local currentTotal = accumulatedDistance
    if isHeld and pickupPosition then
        local currentPos = self.getPosition()
        local dist = Vector.distance(pickupPosition, currentPos) / UNIT_SCALE
        currentTotal = currentTotal + dist
    end

    local text = string.format("Move: %.1f\"", currentTotal)

    -- Only push to UI if text actually changed
    if text ~= lastMovementText then
        lastMovementText = text
        for _, color in ipairs(getConnectedColors()) do
            self.UI.setAttribute(color .. "_MovementDist", "text", text)
        end
    end
end

function recoverState(save)
    if save.state ~= nil then
        state = save.state
    else
        state = {}
        originalData = save.originalData or {}
        state.health = originalData.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
        state.base = originalData.base or { size = ShipbaseSize, color = {r = 1, g = 1, b = 1} }
        state.imageScale = originalData.imageScale or 1.5
        state.sig = originalData.sig or Signature
    end

    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}
    state.conditions.Mode = state.conditions.Mode or 0

    -- Initialize all conditions to 0 if nil

function SetInitialState(newState) -- To be called from the reference card
    state.state = newState.state;
    state.health = newState.health;
    state.base = newState.base;
    state.imageScale = newState.imageScale;
    state.referenceCard = newState.referenceCard;
    state.sig = newState.sig;

    state.Shipcost = newState.shipcost;
    RecalculateSignature() -- Recalculate signature to account for any initial spikes
end

function ModifyHealth(params)
    state = state or {}
    state.health = state.health or { current = Shiphealth, max = Shiphealth }
    state.conditions = state.conditions or {}

    local prevHP = tonumber(state.health.current) or 0

    -- Apply health change (clamped)
    state.health.current = math.max(0, math.min(state.health.max, (state.health.current or 0) + (params.amount or 0)))

    -- Update the health bar UI
    SyncHealth()

    -- If HP just reached 0, force Free Movement ON
    if prevHP > 0 and state.health.current == 0 then
        if (state.conditions.MoveOff or 0) == 0 then
            state.conditions.MoveOff = 1

            -- Free move disables vectored sequencing entirely (match your existing MoveOff behaviour)
            vectoredPhase = 1
            vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
            vectoredReminderActive = false

            -- Optional: also clear course change reminder/guides so nothing keeps drawing
            courseChangePhase = 1
            courseChangeDistance = 0
            courseChangeReminderActive = false
            cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil

            print("[FF4444]" .. (self.getName() or "Ship") .. " reduced to 0 HP, Free Movement enabled.[-]")

            -- Update the MoveOff button visuals immediately
            SyncCondition("MoveOff")
        end
    end
end

function ModifyAura(params)
    local current = state.conditions.Aura or 0
    local target = current + (params.amount or 0)

    -- clamp to 0/1 so it can never stack
    state.conditions.Aura = (target > 0) and 1 or 0

    if state.conditions.Aura > 0 then
        generateFiringArcLines()
        generateScanLines()
    end

    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("Aura")
end

function ModifyBaseSignature(amount)
    SignatureStorage = math.max(0, SignatureStorage + amount)
    RecalculateSignature()
end

function RecalculateSignature()
    local baseSignature = cloaked == 1 and 0 or SignatureStorage
    local spikeBonus = (state.conditions.Spikes or 0) * 3
    local newSig = baseSignature + spikeBonus

    -- Ensure sig doesn't go below 0
    newSig = math.max(0, newSig)

    if newSig ~= state.sig then
        state.sig = newSig

        -- Regenerate signature lines if they're being shown
        if state.sigAuraShown then
            generateSignatureLines()
            updateAuraVisuals()
            print("Signature updated to: " .. state.sig .. " inches")
        end
    end
end

function ShowSig()
    state.sigAuraShown = not state.sigAuraShown
    if state.sigAuraShown then
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 1  -- Light up the button
        generateSignatureLines()  -- Generate the circle
        print("Showing Ship Signature and Spikes. Value:", state.sig," Inches")
    else
        state.conditions.TargetSig = 0  -- Turn off the button
        cachedSignatureLines = nil  -- Clear the lines
    end
    updateAuraVisuals()
    SyncCondition("TargetSig")
end

-- Update the ModifyCondition function to handle fractionNumber wrapping (0-9)
function ModifyCondition(params)
    local previousValue = state.conditions[params.name] or 0  -- Default to 0 if nil
    if params.amount == 0 then -- toggle
        state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, 1 - previousValue)
    else
        if Conditions[params.name].loop ~= nil then
            state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, (previousValue + params.amount + Conditions[params.name].loop) % Conditions[params.name].loop)
        else
            -- Special handling for FractionNumber
            if params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                -- Increment or decrement and wrap around 0-9
                local newValue = (previousValue + params.amount) % 10
                if newValue < 0 then newValue = 9 end  -- Handle negative wrap-around
                state.conditions[params.name] = newValue
                state.fractionNumber = newValue  -- Update the state variable
            else
                state.conditions[params.name] = math.max(0, previousValue + params.amount)
            end
        end
    end
    if params.name == 'Mode' then
        Sync()
    else
        if params.name ~= "MoveNumber" and params.name ~= "FractionNumber" then
            print(self.getData().Nickname .. [[: ']] .. params.name .. [[' ]] .. previousValue .. [[->]] .. state.conditions[params.name])
        else
            if params.name == "MoveNumber" then
                state.moveNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            elseif params.name == "FractionNumber" then
                state.fractionNumber = state.conditions[params.name]
            end
        end
        SyncCondition(params.name)
    end
end

function ModifyMoveRange(params)
    state.move.moveRange = math.max(0, state.move.moveRange + params.amount);
end

function adjustTransparency(baseColor, newAlpha)
    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        self.setColorTint({
            r = baseColor.r,
            g = baseColor.g,
            b = baseColor.b,
            a = newAlpha / 255  -- Normalize alpha value
        })
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not in the expected format or missing r, g, b")
    end
end

function RefreshBaseColor()
    -- Set specific color values (light blue from color picker)
    state.base.color = {
        r = 190/255,
        g = 221/255,
        b = 255/255,
        a = 35/255
    }

    local baseColor = state.base.color

    if type(baseColor) == "table" and baseColor.r and baseColor.g and baseColor.b then
        local alpha = baseColor.a or 1.0

        if state.conditions.Activated == 0 then
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        else
            self.setColorTint({
                r = baseColor.r,
                g = baseColor.g,
                b = baseColor.b,
                a = alpha
            })
        end
    else
        print("Error: baseColor is not properly set in RefreshBaseColor")
    end
end

function SyncCondition(name)
    if not state or not state.conditions or not Conditions then return end

    local conditionData = Conditions[name]
    if not conditionData then
        print("SyncCondition: Unknown condition '" .. tostring(name) .. "'")
        return
    end

    for _, color in ipairs(getConnectedColors()) do
        local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0

        -- Special handling for Status button - show active if any critical status is active
        local isActive
        if name == "Status" then
            isActive = HasCriticalStatus()
            state.conditions.Status = isActive and 1 or 0
        else
            isActive = conditionValue > 0
        end

        local imageUrl
        local colorBlock
        if name == "MoveOff" then
            local moveCond = Conditions["MoveOff"]
            imageUrl = isActive and (moveCond.active_url or moveCond.url) or moveCond.url
            colorBlock = isActive and "#00FF00FF" or "#000000FF"
        else
            imageUrl = isActive and (conditionData.active_url or conditionData.url) or conditionData.url
            if currentUIMode == 0 then
                colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. "FF"
            else
                colorBlock = (conditionData.color or "#FFFFFF") .. (isActive and "FF" or "22")
            end
        end

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionImage_" .. name, {
            color = colorBlock,
            image = imageUrl,
        })

        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_ConditionText_" .. name, {
            active = (conditionData.stacks and isActive) and "true" or "false",
            text = tostring(conditionValue)
        })
    end

    if name == "Activated" then
        ApplyActivatedLockState()
    end
end

function SyncHealth()
    for _, color in ipairs(getConnectedColors()) do
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar_Text", {
            text = state.health.current .. [[/]] .. state.health.max
        });
        self.UI.setAttributes(color .. "_HealthBar", {
            percentage = (state.health.current / state.health.max * 100)
        });
    end
end

-- Cache connected player colors to avoid syncing UI for empty seats
local cachedPlayerColors = {'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}  -- Fallback
local lastPlayerColorCheck = 0

function getConnectedColors()
    -- Refresh at most once per second (60 frames)
    local now = os.clock()
    if now - lastPlayerColorCheck < 1 then
        return cachedPlayerColors
    end
    lastPlayerColorCheck = now

    local colors = {}
    for _, player in ipairs(Player.getPlayers()) do
        if UIStatus[player.color] then
            table.insert(colors, player.color)
        end
    end
    -- Fallback to all if somehow empty (e.g. during load)
    if #colors == 0 then
        cachedPlayerColors = {'Blue', 'Red', 'Grey', 'Black'}
    else
        cachedPlayerColors = colors
    end
    return cachedPlayerColors
end

function HUDSingleCondition(color, name, x, y, size)
    if not color or not name or not x or not y or not size then

function HUDSingleConditionBody(color, name, size)
    if not color or not name or not size or not state.conditions then
        return ""
    end

    local condition = Conditions[name]
    if not condition then
        return ""
    end

    local conditionValue = state.conditions[name] or 0
    local isActive = conditionValue > 0

    local imageUrl
    if name == "MoveOff" then
        local moveCond = Conditions["MoveOff"]
        imageUrl = isActive and (moveCond.active_url or moveCond.url) or moveCond.url
    else
        imageUrl = isActive and condition.active_url or condition.url
    end

    local colorBlock
    if name == "MoveOff" then
        colorBlock = (isActive and "#00FF00FF" or "#ffffff")
    else
        if currentUIMode == 0 then
            colorBlock = condition.color .. "FF"
        else
            local isActive2 = (state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0
            colorBlock = condition.color .. (isActive2 and 'FF' or '22')
        end
    end
    local fontSize = math.floor(size * 0.85 * 2)

    local displayText = name == "Move" and "Move" or tostring(state.conditions[name] or 0)

    return string.format([[
            <Image id="%s_ConditionImage_%s" image="%s" color="%s" rectAlignment='MiddleCenter' width='%d' height='%d'/>
            <Text id="%s_ConditionText_%s" active='%s' fontSize='%d' scale='0.5 0.5 0.5' width='%d' height='%d' text='%s' color='%s' fontStyle='Bold' rectAlignment='LowerRight' outline='%s' outlineSize='%s' />
        ]],
        color, name, imageUrl, colorBlock, size, size,
        color, name, tostring(condition.stacks and ((state.conditions[name] or 0) > 0)), fontSize, size*2, size*2, displayText, TEXT_COLOR, OUTLINE_COLOR, OUTLINE_SIZE)
end

function UI_ModifyAtmosphere(p, alt_click)
    -- Block orbital layer change while Navigation is offline
    if (state.conditions.Navigation_Offline or 0) > 0 then
        broadcastToAll("Cannot change Orbital Layer — Navigation Offline!", {1, 0.4, 0.4})
        return
    end

    local wasInAtmosphere = (state.conditions.Atmosphere or 0) > 0

    UI_ModifyCondition("0", "Atmosphere")

    local nowInAtmosphere = (state.conditions.Atmosphere or 0) > 0
    local shipName = self.getName() or "Unknown Ship"

    if nowInAtmosphere and not wasInAtmosphere then
        -- Entering atmosphere
        preAtmosphereThrust = ShipThrust
        orbitRecoveryPending = false
        ShipThrust = 2
        print("[4488FF]" .. shipName .. " has entered Atmosphere! Thrust locked to 2\" (was " .. preAtmosphereThrust .. "\")[-]")

    elseif not nowInAtmosphere and wasInAtmosphere then
        -- Exiting atmosphere
        if preAtmosphereThrust then
            local penaltyThrust = math.max(0, preAtmosphereThrust - 4)
            orbitRecoveryPending = true
            ShipThrust = penaltyThrust
            print("[FFAA00]" .. shipName .. " is rising to orbit and loses 4\" of Thrust, It's thrust is currently " .. penaltyThrust .. "\" for it's next move[-]")
        else
            -- Safety fallback (shouldn't normally hit this)
            orbitRecoveryPending = false
        end
    end

    Sync()
end

function UI_ModifyMove(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            if not self.getLock() then
                self.setLock(true)
            end

            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local directionMultiplier = alt == '-2' and -1 or 1

            local deltaX = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = directionMultiplier * moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local newPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            self.setPosition(newPos)

            local direction = directionMultiplier == 1 and "forward" or "backward"
            local modelName = self.getName()

            local colorCode = directionMultiplier == 1 and "22AA22" or "AA2222"
            print(modelName .. " has moved " ..
                "[" .. colorCode .. "]" .. direction .. "[-][F4641D] " ..
                string.format("%.1f", moveAmount) .. "[-] inches ")

            showMeasurementLine()
        end
    end
end

function ToggleProjectedArcs()
    local isProjected = state.conditions.ProjectArcs > 0

    if isProjected then
        ProjectArcsForward()
        print("[22AA22] Projecting ship arcs [-]")
    else
        ResetArcs()
        print("[AA2222] Resetting ship arcs [-]")
    end
end

function ProjectArcsForward()
    if state._projectingArcs then return end
    state._projectingArcs = true

    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        local moveWhole = state.conditions.MoveNumber or 0
        local moveFraction = state.conditions.FractionNumber or 0
        local moveAmount = moveWhole + (moveFraction / 10)

        if moveAmount > 0 then
            local currentPos = self.getPosition()
            local rotation = self.getRotation()

            local shipAngle = math.rad(rotation.y)
            local moveAngle = shipAngle + math.rad(90)

            local deltaX = moveAmount * math.sin(moveAngle)
            local deltaZ = moveAmount * math.cos(moveAngle)

            local projectedPos = {
                x = currentPos.x + deltaX,
                y = currentPos.y,
                z = currentPos.z + deltaZ
            }

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('originalParent', self)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', nil)

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(projectedPos)
            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint({r = 0, g = 1, b = 0, a = 0.6})

            ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
                function onUpdate()
                    -- Keep position static when projected
                end
            ]])
        end
    end

    state._projectingArcs = false
end

function ResetArcs()
    if ChildObjs.aura_obj then
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setVar('parent', self)
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setPosition(self.getPosition())

        local clr = self.getColorTint()
        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setColorTint(clr)

        ChildObjs.aura_obj.setLuaScript([[
            function onUpdate()
                if parent and parent.getPosition then
                    self.setPosition(parent.getPosition())
                    self.setRotation(parent.getRotation())
                end
            end
        ]])
    end
end

function UI_ToggleSpikeCapRemoved(p, alt)
    if alt ~= '-3' then

function UI_ModifyStatus(p, alt)

function ApplyActivatedLockState()
    local activated = (state and state.conditions and (state.conditions.Activated or 0) > 0)

    if activated then
        if not self.getLock() then
            self.setLock(true)
        end
    else
        if self.getLock() then
            self.setLock(false)
        end
    end
end

function onCustomMessage(data)
    if data.messageID == BROADCAST_CHANNEL then
      print("UI BUILD activeSpecialOrder =", tostring(state.activeSpecialOrder))
        state.conditions.Activated = 0
        SyncCondition("Activated")
        RefreshBaseColor()

        -- Reset to General Quarters
        state.activeSpecialOrder = "GeneralQuarters"
        state.specialOrdersMenuOpen = false
        state.conditions.SpecialOrders = 0

        -- Clear silent running
        if (state.conditions.Silent_Running or 0) > 0 then
            state.conditions.Silent_Running = 0
            cloaked = 0
            RecalculateSignature()
            SyncCondition("Silent_Running")
        end

        -- Reset movement phases
        courseChangePhase = 1
        courseChangeDistance = 0
        courseChangeReminderActive = false
        cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil
        vectoredPhase = 1
        vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
        vectoredReminderActive = false

        -- Ensure the order icons update
        SyncSpecialOrderVisuals("GeneralQuarters")
        UpdateSpecialOrdersIcon()
        print("UI BUILD activeSpecialOrder =", tostring(state.activeSpecialOrder))
        -- Rebuild UI
        Sync()
    end
end

-- Called by the round tracker at end of round
function RoundReset()
    -- Nuke anything currently drawn
    ClearAllMovementLines()

    -- reset activation
    state.conditions.Activated = 0
    SyncCondition("Activated")

    -- Reset special orders to General Quarters, EXCEPT Silent Running which persists across rounds
    local onSilentRunning = (state.activeSpecialOrder == "SilentRunningOrder")
    if not onSilentRunning then
        state.activeSpecialOrder = "GeneralQuarters"
        state.specialOrdersMenuOpen = false
        state.conditions.SpecialOrders = 0
        -- reset order condition flags (if you rely on these icons)
        SyncSpecialOrderVisuals("GeneralQuarters")
        UpdateSpecialOrdersIcon()
    end

    -- >>> THIS IS THE IMPORTANT BIT <<<
    -- Clear course-change / vectored “reminder” state so guides cannot be redrawn
    courseChangePhase = 1
    courseChangeDistance = 0
    courseChangeReminderActive = false
    cachedCourseChangeGuideLines = nil

    vectoredPhase = 1
    vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
    vectoredReminderActive = false

    -- If you want aura/sig visuals to remain after wiping lines, rebuild them cleanly
    updateAuraVisuals()

    -- Rebuild UI
    Sync()
end

        state.conditions.MoveOff = 0
        print("Radial Movement ENABLED - Ship will use movement restrictions")
    else
        state.conditions.MoveOff = 1

    -- Free move disables vectored sequencing entirely
    if state.conditions.MoveOff and state.conditions.MoveOff > 0 then
        vectoredPhase = 1
        vectoredLeg1Distance = 0
        vectoredReminderActive = false
    end

    Sync()
end
